title: A Cascaded Generative Approach for e-Commerce Recommendations
summary: Personalized storefronts in large e-commerce marketplaces are often assembled from many independent components: static themes per page section ("placement"), retrieval systems to fetch eligible products per placement, and pointwise rankers to order content. While effective in optimizing for aggregate preferences, this paradigm is rigid and can limit personalization and semantic cohesion across the page. This makes it poorly suited to support dynamic objectives and merchandising requirements over time. To address this, we introduce a cascaded merchandising framework that decomposes storefront construction into two generative tasks: (i) placement-level theme generation and (ii) constrained keyword generation per placement to power product retrieval. Teacher-student fine-tuning is leveraged to improve scalability of this framework under production latency and cost constraints. Fine-tuned model ablations are shown to approach closed-weight LLM performance. We further contribute frameworks for AI-driven content evaluation and quality filtering, enabling safe and automated deployment of dynamic content at scale. Generative output is fused with traditional ranking models to preserve hybrid infrastructure. In online experiments, this framework yields an estimated +2.7% lift in cart adds per page view over a strong baseline.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种级联式商品展示框架，将电商个性化店铺首页构建分解为两个生成任务：版位主题生成和约束关键词生成，结合师生微调提升可扩展性，在线上实验中实现了页面浏览购物车添加量+2.7%的提升。
AI.motivation: 传统电商店铺首页由独立组件（静态主题、检索系统、排序模型）拼装而成，虽能优化聚合偏好，但刚性架构限制了页面各版位间的语义一致性和个性化深度，难以适应动态目标与不断变化的商品运营需求。
AI.method: 提出级联式商品展示框架：①版位级主题生成（placement-level theme generation）；②每个版位受约束的关键词生成（constrained keyword generation），用于驱动产品检索。采用师生微调（teacher-student fine-tuning）提升生产环境下的可扩展性，并将生成式输出与传统排序模型融合，保持混合架构。同时构建AI驱动的内容评估与质量过滤框架，实现动态内容的安全自动化部署。
AI.result: 微调后的模型性能接近闭源大语言模型。在线实验中，该框架相较于强基线，在每页面浏览量上的购物车添加量提升了+2.7%。
AI.conclusion: 该级联生成框架有效突破了传统刚性架构的局限性，通过生成式主题与关键词实现了更灵活的个性化商品展示，且师生微调策略使其在成本和延迟约束下可落地生产。
idea_en: Cascaded merchandising framework decomposing storefront construction into placement-level theme generation and constrained keyword generation per placement
Teacher-student fine-tuning strategy to improve scalability of generative LLM-based merchandising under production latency and cost constraints
Hybrid fusion mechanism combining generative output with traditional ranking models for safe gradual deployment
AI-driven content evaluation and quality filtering framework enabling automated deployment of dynamic storefront content at scale
idea_ch: 将店铺首页构建分解为版位级主题生成和约束关键词生成的级联式商品展示框架
基于师生微调策略提升生成式大模型在商品展示场景下的生产可扩展性，满足延迟与成本约束
生成式输出与传统排序模型融合的混合架构，实现安全渐进式部署
AI驱动的内容评估与质量过滤框架，支持大规模动态店铺内容的自动化安全部署

title: EVOCHAMBER: Test-Time Co-evolution of Multi-Agent System at Individual, Team, and Population Scales
summary: We argue that multi-agent test-time evolution is not single-agent evolution replicated N times. A single-agent learner can only evolve its own context and memory. A multi-agent system additionally evolves who collaborates, how they collaborate, and how knowledge flows across the population. These components have no single-agent counterpart and can produce phenomena such as emergent specialization. Yet prior test-time methods either confine experiences to individual agents, forfeiting cross-agent learning, or broadcast symmetrically to all agents, erasing the specialization that makes collaboration valuable. We present EVOCHAMBER, a training-free framework that instantiates test-time evolution at three levels over a coevolving agent pool. At its core is CODREAM (Collaborative Dreaming), a post-task protocol triggered on team failure or disagreement, in which agents collaboratively reflect, distill insights, and route them asymmetrically from strong to weak agents on the failed niche, preserving specialization while filling knowledge gaps. Team-level operators assemble niche-conditioned teams and select collaboration structures online. Population-level lifecycle operators fork, merge, prune, and seed agents under performance pressure. On three heterogeneous task streams with Qwen3-8B, EVOCHAMBER reaches 63.9% on competition math, 75.7% on code, and 87.1% on multi-domain reasoning, outperforming the best baseline by 32% relative on math and confirming asymmetric cross-agent transfer as the primary driver in ablation. Starting from several identically initialized agents, four to five stable niche specialists spontaneously emerge, a structural signature of multi-agent evolution that no single-agent learner can express. See our code at: https://github.com/Mercury7353/EvoChamber

AI.tldr: 本文提出EVOCHAMBER，一个无需训练的多智能体测试时进化框架，通过三层进化（个体、团队、种群）和不对称知识传递机制（CODREAM），在异构任务流上显著超越基线，并自发涌现出稳定的专业化分工。
AI.motivation: 现有测试时方法要么将经验限制在单个智能体内部（丧失跨智能体学习），要么对称广播给所有智能体（消除专业化分工），缺乏多智能体特有的协作结构、知识流动和专业化涌现等进化机制。
AI.method: 提出EVOCHAMBER框架：（1）CODREAM协议——在团队失败或分歧后，智能体协作反思、提炼洞察，并从强智能体向弱智能体不对称路由知识，同时保留专业化；（2）团队级算子——根据 niche 组建条件化团队并在线选择协作结构；（3）种群级生命周期算子——对智能体进行分叉、合并、剪枝和种子注入。
AI.result: 在Qwen3-8B上，竞争数学达63.9%、代码达75.7%、多领域推理达87.1%，数学任务相对最优基线提升32%。从多个相同初始化的智能体出发，自发涌现4-5个稳定的专业niche智能体。
AI.conclusion: 多智能体测试时进化不同于单智能体进化的简单复制，不对称跨智能体知识迁移是性能提升的主要驱动力，且能自发产生单智能体无法表达的涌现专业化结构。
idea_en: A multi-agent collaborative reflection protocol (CODREAM) that asymmetrically routes distilled insights from strong agents to weak agents on specific failed niches, preserving specialization while filling knowledge gaps
A niche-conditioned team assembly mechanism that dynamically selects collaboration structures online based on task failure patterns and agent expertise
A population-level lifecycle management system with fork, merge, prune, and seed operators that evolve agent populations under performance pressure
A training-free multi-agent test-time evolution framework operating simultaneously at individual, team, and population levels
An automatic emergent specialization mechanism where stable niche specialists spontaneously arise from identically initialized agents through asymmetric knowledge transfer
idea_ch: 一种非对称协作反思协议（CODREAM），在特定失败任务上从强智能体向弱智能体非对称路由蒸馏后的洞察，既保留专业化分工又填补知识缺口
一种基于任务失败模式的动态niche条件化团队组建机制，在线选择协作结构
一种种群级生命周期管理系统，通过分叉、合并、剪枝和种子注入算子，在性能压力下进化智能体种群
一种无需训练的多智能体测试时进化框架，同时在个体、团队和种群三个层面运作
一种自动涌现专业化机制：从多个相同初始化的智能体出发，通过非对称知识迁移自发形成稳定的专业niche智能体

title: RankQ: Offline-to-Online Reinforcement Learning via Self-Supervised Action Ranking
summary: Offline-to-online reinforcement learning (RL) improves sample efficiency by leveraging pre-collected datasets prior to online interaction. A key challenge, however, is learning an accurate critic in large state--action spaces with limited dataset coverage. To mitigate harmful updates from value overestimation, prior methods impose pessimism by down-weighting out-of-distribution (OOD) actions relative to dataset actions. While effective, this essentially acts as a behavior cloning anchor and can hinder downstream online policy improvement when dataset actions are suboptimal. We propose RankQ, an offline-to-online Q-learning objective that augments temporal-difference learning with a self-supervised multi-term ranking loss to enforce structured action ordering. By learning relative action preferences rather than uniformly penalizing unseen actions, RankQ shapes the Q-function such that action gradients are directed toward higher-quality behaviors. Across sparse reward D4RL benchmarks, RankQ achieves performance competitive with or superior to seven prior methods. In vision-based robot learning, RankQ enables effective offline-to-online fine-tuning of a pretrained vision-language-action (VLA) model in a low-data regime, achieving on average a 42.7% higher simulation success rate than the next best method. In a high-data setting, RankQ improves simulation performance by 13.7% over the next best method and achieves strong sim-to-real transfer, increasing real-world cube stacking success from 43.1% to 84.7% relative to the VLA's initial performance.

AI.tldr: 提出RankQ方法，通过自监督多术语排序损失改进离线到在线强化学习中的Q函数学习，在稀疏奖励基准和视觉机器人学习中取得显著性能提升。
AI.motivation: 离线到在线强化学习中，在状态-动作空间大且数据集覆盖有限的情况下，现有悲观方法对OOD动作统一惩罚会限制策略改进，需要更精细的动作价值排序机制。
AI.method: RankQ在时序差分学习中引入自监督多术语排序损失，通过学习动作的相对偏好而非统一惩罚来塑造Q函数，使动作梯度指向更高质量的行为。
AI.result: 在D4RL基准上达到或超越七种先前方法；在视觉机器人学习中，低数据场景成功率提升42.7%，高数据场景提升13.7%，真实世界堆叠成功率从43.1%提升至84.7%。
AI.conclusion: 通过学习相对动作偏好而非统一惩罚OOD动作，RankQ有效解决了离线到在线强化学习的价值过估计问题，同时保留了策略改进能力。
idea_en: A self-supervised multi-term ranking loss function for offline-to-online Q-learning that enforces structured action ordering
A method for shaping Q-function through learning relative action preferences rather than uniformly penalizing out-of-distribution actions
An offline-to-online RL framework that directs action gradients toward higher-quality behaviors via ranking-based Q-learning objective
idea_ch: 一种用于离线到在线Q学习中的自监督多术语排序损失函数，强制学习结构化的动作排序
一种通过学习相对动作偏好而非统一惩罚分布外动作来塑造Q函数的方法
一种通过基于排序的Q学习目标将动作梯度导向更高质量行为的离线到在线强化学习框架

title: OLIVIA: Online Learning via Inference-time Action Adaptation for Decision Making in LLM ReAct Agents
summary: Large language model agents interleave reasoning, action selection, and observation to solve sequential decision-making tasks. In deployed settings where agents repeatedly handle related multi-step tasks, small action-selection errors can accumulate into wasted tool calls, latency, and reduced reliability. Despite this need for deployment-time improvement, existing inference-time adaptation methods for LLM agents mainly rely on prompting or retrieval, which influence behavior indirectly through context manipulation. For ReAct-style agents, such approaches do not expose an explicit decision layer that can score candidate actions, represent uncertainty, or be updated online from action-level feedback. As a result, they provide limited support for trackable, fine-grained, and uncertainty-aware adaptation during deployment. We propose OLIVIA, an inference-time action adaptation framework for ReAct-style agents. OLIVIA models the LLM's final action-selection layer as a contextual linear bandit over candidate actions, with frozen hidden states as decision contexts. This choice is particularly suitable for deployment because it adapts behavior directly at the action-selection interface, preserves the underlying reasoning process, and provides explicit uncertainty estimates and lightweight online updates from action-level feedback. With upper-confidence-bound exploration, OLIVIA improves the policy sample-efficiently with minimal computational overhead. We instantiate OLIVIA on four benchmarks and show that it consistently improves task performance over static ReAct and prompt-based inference-time baselines. Our results suggest that explicit online decision layers provide an effective alternative to purely prompt- or retrieval-based adaptation for LLM agents during deployment.

AI.tldr: OLIVIA框架将ReAct风格LLM代理的最终动作选择层建模为上下文线性老虎机，通过在线决策层实现部署时的轻量级、不确定性感知的动作适配，提升任务性能。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM代理在部署中处理多步任务时，小的动作选择错误会累积，导致工具调用浪费、延迟增加和可靠性下降。而现有的推理时适配方法（提示/检索）缺乏显式决策层，无法对候选动作评分、表达不确定性或从动作级反馈在线更新，限制了部署时的细粒度自适应能力。
AI.method: 提出OLIVIA框架，将ReAct代理的最终动作选择层建模为上下文线性老虎机（contextual linear bandit），使用冻结的隐藏状态作为决策上下文，采用上置信界（UCB）探索策略，从动作级反馈进行轻量级在线更新。
AI.result: 在四个基准测试上，OLIVIA一致优于静态ReAct和基于提示的推理时基线方法，证明了显式在线决策层在LLM代理部署中的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 显式在线决策层为纯提示或检索型适配方法提供了有效替代方案，能在部署阶段以最小计算开销实现样本高效的动作策略改进。
idea_en: A method for real-time action adaptation in LLM agents by modeling the final action selection layer as a contextual linear bandit, using frozen hidden states as decision contexts.
An online fine-grained adaptation system for ReAct-style agents that provides explicit uncertainty estimates via upper-confidence-bound (UCB) exploration during deployment.
A lightweight update mechanism for LLM agent action policies that learns from action-level feedback without modifying the underlying reasoning model.
A system combining frozen LLM hidden states with a trainable bandit layer for sample-efficient policy improvement in sequential decision-making tasks.
An inference-time framework that preserves the original reasoning process while enabling trackable, uncertainty-aware action selection through an explicit decision interface.
idea_ch: 一种将LLM代理的最终动作选择层建模为上下文线性老虎机，利用冻结的隐藏状态作为决策上下文，实现实时动作适配的方法
一种为ReAct风格代理设计的在线细粒度适配系统，在部署阶段通过上置信界探索提供显式的不确定性估计
一种LLM代理动作策略的轻量级更新机制，从动作级反馈中学习而无需修改底层推理模型
一种结合冻结LLM隐藏状态与可训练老虎机层的系统，在序列决策任务中实现样本高效的政策改进
一种在推理时保持原始推理过程的同时，通过显式决策接口实现可追踪、不确定性感知的动作选择的框架

title: The Many Faces of On-Policy Distillation: Pitfalls, Mechanisms, and Fixes
summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) and on-policy self-distillation (OPSD) have emerged as promising post-training methods for large language models, offering dense token-level supervision on trajectories sampled from the model's own policy. However, existing results on their effectiveness remain mixed: while OP(S)D has shown promise in system prompt and knowledge internalization, recent studies also report instability and degradation. In this work, we present a comprehensive empirical study of when OPD and OPSD work, when they fail, and why. We find that OPD on mathematical reasoning is highly sensitive to teacher choice and loss formulation, whereas OPSD fails in our tested settings due to test-time absence of instance-specific privileged information (PI). In contrast, OPSD is effective when PI represents a shared latent rule, such as a system prompt or alignment preference. We identify three failure mechanisms: (1) distribution mismatch between teacher and student caused by conditioning on student-generated prefixes, (2) optimization instability from biased TopK reverse-KL gradients, and (3) an OPSD-specific limitation where the student learns a PI-free policy that aggregates PI-conditioned teachers, which is insufficient when PI is instance-specific. We further show that stop-gradient TopK objectives, RLVR-adapted teachers, and SFT-stabilized students mitigate these failures.

AI.tldr: 本文系统研究了在线知识蒸馏（OPD）和在线自蒸馏（OPSD）在大型语言模型后训练中的有效性，发现它们在数学推理、系统提示内化等场景下表现各异，并识别出三种失败机制，提出了相应的缓解方法。
AI.motivation: 现有关于OPD和OPSD的研究结果不一致，有些显示有效，有些则出现不稳定和性能退化。本文旨在系统性地探究何时有效、何时失败及其原因。
AI.method: 通过大量实证实验，分析OPD和OPSD在不同场景（数学推理、系统提示内化、对齐偏好）下的表现，识别失败机制，并提出stop-gradient TopK目标、RLVR适应的教师模型和SFT稳定的学生模型等缓解策略。
AI.result: OPD对数学推理高度敏感于教师选择和损失函数；OPSD在实例特定的特权信息缺失时失败，但在共享潜在规则（如系统提示或对齐偏好）下有效。识别出三种失败机制：分布不匹配、优化不稳定性和OPSD特定的PI-free策略不足。
AI.conclusion: OPD和OPSD的效果高度依赖于场景和设置，提出的缓解方法可以有效克服其失败机制，为LLM后训练提供了实用指导。
idea_en: A method for stabilizing on-policy distillation by applying stop-gradient to TopK objectives, preventing gradient bias from biased TopK reverse-KL gradients.
A system for adapting teachers using RLVR (Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards) to mitigate distribution mismatch between teacher and student during on-policy distillation.
A technique for pre-stabilizing student models with SFT (Supervised Fine-Tuning) before on-policy self-distillation to reduce optimization instability.

A method for distinguishing between instance-specific privileged information and shared latent rules in on-policy self-distillation, enabling selective application of OPSD only when PI represents a shared rule.
A mechanism for conditioning teacher models on student-generated prefixes to reduce distribution mismatch in on-policy distillation for mathematical reasoning tasks.
idea_ch: 一种通过将stop-gradient应用于TopK目标来稳定在线蒸馏的方法，防止由有偏TopK反向KL梯度引起的梯度偏差。
一种使用RLVR（带可验证奖励的强化学习）适应教师模型的系统，用于缓解在线蒸馏中教师与学生之间的分布不匹配。
一种在在线自蒸馏之前使用SFT（监督微调）预稳定学生模型的技术，以减少优化不稳定性。
一种区分在线自蒸馏中实例特定特权信息与共享潜在规则的方法，使得仅在PI代表共享规则时选择性应用OPSD。
一种在数学推理任务的在线蒸馏中，通过基于学生生成的前缀条件化教师模型来减少分布不匹配的机制。

title: Don't Look at the Numbers: Visual Anchoring Bias and Layer-wise Representation in VLMs
summary: Embedded numeric anchors on images systematically bias Vision-Language Model quality judgments across six VLMs from five architectural families (ANOVA eta^2 = 0.18-0.77, all p < 0.001). Anchor effects are 2.5x larger than severe image quality degradation, confirming bias is not reducible to visual changes. Layer-wise probing reveals consistent dissociation: layers where anchor classification saturates (L12-L34) are suboptimal for quality prediction, with optimal layers deeper (R^2 = 0.69-0.91). Fusion analysis identifies architecture-dependent integration -- instant fusion at L1-L2 in two models versus partial or no fusion in three others. These results establish a causal account of visual anchoring bias, linking behavioral susceptibility to representation dynamics.

AI.tldr: 论文发现图像中的嵌入数字锚点会系统性偏置视觉-语言模型的质量判断，锚点效应比严重图像质量退化大2.5倍，并通过层分析揭示了表征动态与偏误之间的因果关系。
AI.motivation: 探究视觉-语言模型在图像质量判断中是否存在数字锚点偏误（anchoring bias），以及这种偏误的机制和表征基础。
AI.method: 使用6个VLM（来自5个架构家族），通过嵌入数字锚点进行实验，采用ANOVA分析效应量，进行逐层探针分析锚点分类与质量预测的层分布，以及融合分析研究信息整合方式。
AI.result: 锚点效应显著（eta^2=0.18-0.77），效应量是严重图像质量退化的2.5倍；锚点分类饱和层（L12-L34）对质量预测非最优，更深层表现更好（R^2=0.69-0.91）；架构间信息融合方式存在差异（即时融合、部分融合、无融合）。
AI.conclusion: 建立了视觉锚定偏误的因果解释，将行为层面的偏误敏感性与表征动态联系起来，揭示了VLM内部处理锚点信息与质量信息时的分离机制。
idea_en: A method for detecting and quantifying anchoring bias in vision-language models by embedding controlled numeric anchors into images and measuring their disproportionate effect on model judgments relative to actual image quality changes.

A layer-wise probing technique to identify optimal and sub-optimal neural network layers for quality prediction, revealing dissociation between anchor classification saturation layers and quality judgment layers.

A fusion analysis framework for characterizing architecture-dependent information integration patterns (instant fusion, partial fusion, no fusion) in multi-modal models processing embedded numeric cues.
A causal diagnostic system for vision-language models that uses embedded numeric anchors as probes to map representation dynamics and bias susceptibility across different architectural families.
A calibration method that leverages deeper-layer representations (beyond anchor saturation layers) to mitigate anchoring bias in VLM quality judgments.
idea_ch: 一种通过在图像中嵌入受控数字锚点并测量其对模型判断的 disproportionate 影响（相对于实际图像质量变化）来检测和量化视觉-语言模型中锚定偏误的方法。
一种逐层探针技术，用于识别神经网络中质量预测的最优层和非最优层，揭示锚点分类饱和层与质量判断层之间的分离机制。
一种融合分析框架，用于表征多模态模型在处理嵌入数字线索时依赖于架构的信息整合模式（即时融合、部分融合、无融合）。
一种视觉-语言模型的因果诊断系统，利用嵌入数字锚点作为探针，映射不同架构家族的表示动态和偏误易感性。
一种利用更深层表示（超越锚点饱和层）来减轻VLM质量判断中锚定偏误的校准方法。

title: Do Vision-Language-Models show human-like logical problem-solving capability in point and click puzzle games?
summary: Vision-Language(-Action) Models (VLMs) are increasingly applied to interactive environments, yet existing benchmarks often overlook the complex physical reasoning required for point-and-click puzzle games. This paper introduces Vision-Language Against The Incredible Machine (VLATIM), a benchmark designed to evaluate human-like logical problem-solving capabilities within the classic physics puzzle game The Incredible Machine 2 (TIM). Unlike existing benchmarks, VLATIM specifically targets the critical gap between high-level logical reasoning and continuous action spaces requiring precise mouse interactions. This benchmark is structured into five progressive parts, assessing capabilities that range from basic visual grounding and domain understanding to multi-step manipulation and full puzzle solving. Our results reveal a significant disparity between reasoning and execution. While large proprietary models demonstrate superior planning abilities, they struggle with precise visual grounding. Consequently, they do not yet show human-like problem-solving capabilities.

AI.tldr: 本文提出VLATIM基准测试，用于评估视觉-语言模型在物理谜题游戏《The Incredible Machine 2》中的类人逻辑推理能力。研究发现，虽然大型专有模型在规划方面表现优异，但在精确视觉定位和执行能力上仍存在显著差距。
AI.motivation: 现有基准测试忽视了点点击谜题游戏中所需的复杂物理推理能力，特别是高层逻辑推理与连续动作空间（精确鼠标交互）之间的关键差距。
AI.method: 构建了VLATIM基准测试，包含五个递进部分：基础视觉定位、领域理解、多步操作、完整谜题解决等，评估VLM在物理推理游戏中的表现。
AI.result: 大型专有模型在规划能力上表现优越，但精确视觉定位能力不足，推理与执行之间存在显著差距，尚未达到类人问题解决水平。
AI.conclusion: 当前VLM在物理推理游戏中仍无法实现类人级问题解决能力，推理与执行之间存在鸿沟，需要进一步改进。
idea_en: A method for evaluating VLM physical reasoning using progressive difficulty levels in physics puzzle games
A technique for measuring the gap between high-level planning and precise visual grounding in continuous action spaces
A benchmark design that decomposes complex puzzle-solving into five progressive sub-tasks for VLM assessment
idea_ch: 基于物理谜题游戏递进难度级别的视觉-语言模型物理推理能力评估方法
测量高层规划与连续动作空间中精确视觉定位之间差距的技术
将复杂谜题求解分解为五个递进子任务以评估视觉-语言模型能力的基准设计

title: PIVOT: Bridging Planning and Execution in LLM Agents via Trajectory Refinement
summary: Large language model (LLM)-based agents frequently generate seemingly coherent plans that fail upon execution due to infeasible actions, constraint violations, and compounding errors over extended horizons. PIVOT (Plan-Inspect-eVOlve Trajectories) addresses this plan-execution misalignment through a self-supervised framework that treats trajectories as optimizable objects iteratively refined via environment interaction. The framework comprises four stages: PLAN generates candidate trajectories; INSPECT executes them and computes structured losses with textual gradients encoding plan-execution discrepancies; EVOLVE applies these signals to produce improved trajectories; and VERIFY performs a final global check against task constraints. A monotonic acceptance process ensures a non-decreasing solution quality. Empirical evaluations on DeepPlanning and GAIA demonstrate state-of-the-art performance: with human-in-the-loop (HITL) feedback, PIVOT establishes a strong upper bound up to 94% relative improvement in constraint satisfaction, while its fully autonomous variant retains substantial gains, showing that the core trajectory-refinement mechanism remains effective without external supervision. At the same time, PIVOT remains computationally efficient, requiring up to 3x to 5x fewer tokens than competing refinement methods. These findings establish that (self- or human-supervised) feedback-based trajectory optimization is a principled methodology for mitigating plan-execution gaps in autonomous agent systems.

AI.tldr: PIVOT是一个基于自我监督的轨迹优化框架，通过PLAN-INSPECT-EVOLVE-VERIFY四个阶段迭代改进LLM智能体生成的计划，解决规划与执行之间的脱节问题，在DeepPlanning和GAIA上取得SOTA效果，且比竞品节省3-5倍token。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体生成的计划看似合理但执行时常失败，原因包括不可行动作、约束违反以及长程任务中的累积错误，亟需解决规划与执行之间的对齐问题。
AI.method: PIVOT包含四个阶段：PLAN生成候选轨迹；INSPECT执行轨迹并计算结构化损失，生成文本梯度编码计划-执行差异；EVOLVE利用这些信号生成改进轨迹；VERIFY进行最终全局检查。采用单调接受过程确保解质量非递减。
AI.result: 在DeepPlanning和GAIA上达到SOTA；引入人类在环时，约束满足率相对提升高达94%；完全自主变体仍保持显著增益；token消耗比竞品方法少3-5倍。
AI.conclusion: 反馈驱动的轨迹优化（无论是人工监督还是自我监督）是一种缓解自主智能体系统中规划-执行差距的原则性方法论。
idea_en: A self-supervised trajectory optimization framework that treats agent trajectories as optimizable objects, iteratively refined through environment interaction without requiring human annotations.
A structured loss computation method with textual gradients that encode plan-execution discrepancies, enabling fine-grained feedback for trajectory improvement.
A monotonic acceptance process that ensures non-decreasing solution quality during iterative trajectory refinement.
A four-stage pipeline (PLAN-INSPECT-EVOLVE-VERIFY) for closed-loop plan-execution alignment in LLM-based agents.
A computationally efficient refinement mechanism that achieves 3x-5x token reduction compared to competing methods while maintaining or improving plan quality.
idea_ch: 一种将智能体轨迹视为可优化对象的自监督轨迹优化框架，通过环境交互迭代精炼轨迹，无需人工标注。
一种带有文本梯度的结构化损失计算方法，编码计划-执行差异，为轨迹改进提供细粒度反馈信号。
一种单调接受过程机制，确保迭代轨迹精炼过程中解质量非递减。
一种四阶段流水线（PLAN-INSPECT-EVOLVE-VERIFY），用于LLM智能体的闭环计划-执行对齐。
一种高效的计算精炼机制，相比竞品方法减少3-5倍token消耗，同时保持或提升计划质量。

title: Rethinking LLMOps for Fraud and AML: Building a Compliance-Grade LLM Serving Stack
summary: Fraud detection and anti-money-laundering (AML) compliance are high-value domains for large language models (LLMs), but their serving requirements differ sharply from generic chat workloads. Compliance prompts are often prefix-heavy, schema-constrained, and evidence-rich, combining reusable policy instructions, risk taxonomies, transaction or document context, and short structured outputs such as JSON labels or risk factors. These properties make prefix reuse, KV-cache efficiency, runtime tuning, model orchestration, and output validation first-order systems concerns. This paper introduces a workload-aware LLMOps stack for fraud and AML workloads using self-hosted open-weight models such as Meta Llama and Alibaba Qwen. The stack combines vLLM-style runtime tuning, PagedAttention, Automatic Prefix Caching, multi-adapter serving, adapter and prompt-length-aware batching, sleep/wake lifecycle management, speculative decoding, and optional prefill/decode disaggregation. To avoid exposing institution-specific data, the reproducibility track converts public synthetic AML datasets, including IBM AML and SAML-D, into prefix-heavy compliance prompts with reusable policy text, transaction evidence, typology definitions, and schema-constrained outputs. We also incorporate an LLM-as-judge quality gate using deterministic compliance checks, reference metrics, expert-adjudicated calibration data where available, and multi-judge rubric scoring. Across public-synthetic AML workloads and controlled serving benchmarks, workload-aware tuning improved throughput from 612-650 to 3,600 requests/hour, reduced P99 latency from 31-38 seconds to 6.4-8.7 seconds, and increased GPU utilization from 12% to 78%. These results show that regulated LLM performance is a workload-design, serving-optimization, and quality-gating problem, not only a model-selection problem.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一套面向欺诈检测和反洗钱（AML）场景的、工作负载感知的LLMOps技术栈，通过vLLM运行时调优、PagedAttention、自动前缀缓存、多适配器服务、批处理优化、生命周期管理、推测解码及prefill/decode分离等优化，在自托管开源模型上实现了吞吐量从612-650提升至3600请求/小时、P99延迟从31-38秒降至6.4-8.7秒、GPU利用率从12%提升至78%的显著效果。
AI.motivation: 欺诈检测和反洗钱合规是LLM的高价值应用领域，但其服务需求与传统通用聊天工作负载截然不同。合规提示通常具有前缀密集、模式受限、证据丰富的特点，需要可复用的策略指令、风险分类法、交易/文档上下文以及短结构化输出（如JSON标签）。这些特性使得前缀复用、KV缓存效率、运行时调优、模型编排和输出验证成为首要的系统级问题。
AI.method: 构建了一套工作负载感知的LLMOps技术栈，结合了vLLM风格的运行时调优、PagedAttention注意力机制、自动前缀缓存（Automatic Prefix Caching）、多适配器服务、适配器和提示长度感知的批处理、休眠/唤醒生命周期管理、推测解码（Speculative Decoding），以及可选的prefill/decode分离架构。使用公开的合成AML数据集（IBM AML和SAML-D）转换为前缀密集的合规提示。引入LLM-as-judge质量门控，包含确定性合规检查、参考指标、专家裁定的校准数据以及多裁判评分机制。
AI.result: 在公开合成AML工作负载和受控服务基准测试中，工作负载感知调优将吞吐量从612-650提升至3600请求/小时，P99延迟从31-38秒降低至6.4-8.7秒，GPU利用率从12%提升至78%。
AI.conclusion: 受监管的LLM性能不仅是一个模型选择问题，更是一个工作负载设计、服务优化和质量门控的问题。
idea_en: A workload-aware LLMOps stack specifically optimized for fraud detection and anti-money laundering (AML) compliance that combines vLLM-style runtime tuning, PagedAttention, Automatic Prefix Caching, multi-adapter serving, adapter and prompt-length-aware batching, sleep/wake lifecycle management, speculative decoding, and prefill/decode disaggregation.

A method for converting public synthetic AML datasets (IBM AML and SAML-D) into prefix-heavy compliance prompts with reusable policy text, transaction evidence, typology definitions, and schema-constrained outputs for LLM training and evaluation without exposing institution-specific data.

An LLM-as-judge quality gate system for regulated environments that integrates deterministic compliance checks, reference metrics, expert-adjudicated calibration data, and multi-judge rubric scoring for validating structured outputs in fraud and AML scenarios.
A prompt-length-aware batching mechanism that dynamically groups requests based on adapter type and prompt length to optimize GPU utilization and throughput for prefix-heavy compliance workloads.
A sleep/wake lifecycle management system for LLM serving that automatically activates and deactivates model instances based on workload demand patterns in fraud and AML applications.
A speculative decoding acceleration technique adapted for schema-constrained structured outputs (JSON labels, risk factors) commonly used in AML and fraud detection compliance prompts.
idea_ch: 一种面向欺诈检测和反洗钱合规场景的工作负载感知LLMOps技术栈，结合了vLLM风格的运行时调优、PagedAttention、自动前缀缓存、多适配器服务、适配器和提示长度感知的批处理、休眠/唤醒生命周期管理、推测解码以及prefill/decode分离架构。
一种将公开合成AML数据集（IBM AML和SAML-D）转换为前缀密集的合规提示的方法，包含可复用的策略文本、交易证据、类型定义和模式约束输出，无需暴露机构特定数据即可用于LLM训练和评估。
一种面向受监管环境的LLM-as-judge质量门控系统，集成了确定性合规检查、参考指标、专家裁决校准数据和多裁判评分机制，用于验证欺诈和反洗钱场景中的结构化输出。
一种提示长度感知的批处理机制，根据适配器类型和提示长度动态分组请求，以优化前缀密集型合规工作负载的GPU利用率和吞吐量。
一种用于LLM服务的休眠/唤醒生命周期管理系统，根据欺诈和反洗钱应用中的工作负载需求模式自动激活和停用模型实例。
一种针对反洗钱和欺诈检测合规提示中常用的模式约束结构化输出（JSON标签、风险因子）进行优化的推测解码加速技术。

title: The Semantic Training Gap: Ontology-Grounded Tool Architectures for Industrial AI Agent Systems
summary: Large language model (LLM)-based AI agents are increasingly deployed in manufacturing environments for analytics, quality management, and decision support. These agents demonstrate statistical fluency with domain terminology but lack grounded understanding of operational semantics -- the relational structure that connects equipment identifiers, process parameters, failure codes, and regulatory constraints within a specific production context. This paper identifies and formalizes the semantic training gap: a structural disconnect between how AI systems acquire domain vocabulary through training and how manufacturing operations define meaning through ontological relationships. We demonstrate that this gap causes operationally incorrect outputs even when model responses are linguistically precise, and that in multi-agent configurations it produces a compounding failure mode we term semantic drift. To close this gap, we present an architecture that embeds manufacturing ontology directly into the AI tool layer as a typed relational configuration, enforcing semantic constraints at runtime rather than relying on model training. The architecture is formalized as a three-operation interface contract -- resolve, contextualize, annotate -- with invariants enforced by an AIOps orchestration layer. In a controlled experiment across six industry configurations (72 tool invocations using Qwen3-32B), unconstrained tool parameters produced a 43% hallucination rate for domain identifiers; ontology-grounded parameters reduced this to 0%. We validate the approach through a digital twin analytics platform demonstrating that a single codebase with domain-specific ontology configurations eliminates tool-call hallucination and achieves cross-domain configurability without application code changes.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种通过将制造本体嵌入AI工具层来消除LLM智能体在制造环境中语义幻觉的架构，在六个工业配置的实验中，将领域标识符的幻觉率从43%降至0%。
AI.motivation: LLM在制造环境中虽能流利使用领域术语，但缺乏对操作语义（设备标识符、工艺参数、故障代码、监管约束之间的本体关系）的接地理解，导致输出在语言上精确但在操作上错误，且在多智能体配置中产生"语义漂移"的复合故障模式。
AI.method: 提出将制造本体直接嵌入AI工具层作为类型化关系配置，在运行时而非依赖训练来强制语义约束。形式化为三操作接口契约（resolve解析、contextualize上下文化、annotate标注），由AIOps编排层强制执行不变性。
AI.result: 在72次工具调用实验中，未约束工具参数的领域标识符幻觉率43%，本体接地参数降至0%。通过数字孪生分析平台验证：单一代码库配合领域特定本体配置即可消除工具调用幻觉，且无需修改应用代码即可实现跨领域可配置性。
AI.conclusion: 本体嵌入工具层而非依赖模型训练可以根本性地解决LLM在制造领域的语义接地问题，为工业AI系统的可靠性提供了可行的架构方案。
idea_en: A typed relational configuration architecture embedding manufacturing ontology directly into the AI tool layer to enforce semantic constraints at runtime rather than during model training
A three-operation interface contract (resolve, contextualize, annotate) with invariants enforced by an AIOps orchestration layer for manufacturing AI agents
A method for eliminating tool-call hallucination in LLM-based manufacturing agents through ontology-grounded parameter constraints
A cross-domain configurable digital twin analytics platform using domain-specific ontology configurations without application code changes
A semantic drift prevention mechanism for multi-agent configurations in manufacturing environments using runtime ontology enforcement
idea_ch: 一种将制造本体作为类型化关系配置直接嵌入AI工具层，在运行时而非训练阶段强制语义约束的架构
一种由AIOps编排层强制执行不变性的三操作接口契约（解析、上下文化、标注），用于制造AI智能体
一种通过本体接地参数约束消除基于LLM的制造智能体工具调用幻觉的方法
一种利用领域特定本体配置实现跨领域可配置性的数字孪生分析平台，无需修改应用代码
一种针对制造环境中多智能体配置，通过运行时本体强制防止语义漂移的机制

title: Unlocking LLM Creativity in Science through Analogical Reasoning
summary: Autonomous science promises to augment scientific discovery, particularly in complex fields like biomedicine. However, this requires AI systems that can consistently generate novel and diverse solutions to open-ended problems. We evaluate LLMs on the task of open-ended solution generation and quantify their tendency to mode collapse into low-diversity generations. To mitigate this mode collapse, we introduce analogical reasoning (AR) as a new approach to solution generation. AR generates analogies to cross-domain problems based on shared relational structure, then uses those analogies to search for novel solutions. Compared to baselines, AR discovers significantly more diverse generations (improving solution diversity metrics by 90-173%), generates novel solutions over 50% of the time (compared to as little as 1.6% for baselines), and produces high-quality analogies. To validate the real-world feasibility of AR, we implement AR-generated solutions across four biomedical problems, yielding consistent quantitative gains. AR-generated approaches achieve a nearly 13-fold improvement on distributional metrics for perturbation effect prediction, outperform all baselines on AUPRC when predicting cell-cell communication, infer brain region interactions with a high Spearman correlation ($ρ$=0.729) to published methods, and establish state-of-the-art performance on 2 datasets for oligonucleotide property prediction. The novel and diverse solutions produced by AR can be used to augment the search space of existing solution generation methods.

AI.tldr: 本文提出类比推理（AR）方法来缓解大语言模型在开放式问题求解中的模式坍塌问题，使AI能生成更多样化、新颖的解决方案，并在四个生物医学问题上验证了其实用性，取得显著性能提升。
AI.motivation: 自主科学需要AI系统能够一致地生成新颖且多样化的解决方案来解决开放式问题。然而，现有LLM在开放式解决方案生成任务中容易出现模式坍塌（mode collapse），即生成低多样性的解决方案，限制了其创新潜力。
AI.method: 提出类比推理（Analogical Reasoning, AR）方法：先基于共享的关系结构生成跨领域问题的类比，然后利用这些类比来搜索新颖的解决方案。该方法引导LLM从不同领域借鉴结构相似的问题及其解法，从而突破原有领域的思维局限。
AI.result: AR在多样性指标上提升90-173%；超过50%的时间生成新颖解决方案（基线最低仅1.6%）；在四个生物医学问题上均取得定量提升：扰动效应预测任务的分布指标提升近13倍、细胞间通讯预测AUPRC优于所有基线、脑区交互推断与已发表方法Spearman相关系数达0.729、寡核苷酸性质预测在两个数据集上达到SOTA。
AI.conclusion: 类比推理是一种有效的开放式解决方案生成方法，能够显著增强AI系统的创新能力，其生成的新颖多样解决方案可用于扩展现有方法的搜索空间，在自主科学发现领域具有重要应用前景。
idea_en: A method for open-ended solution generation using analogical reasoning that maps cross-domain problems based on shared relational structures to generate novel solutions.
A system that mitigates mode collapse in LLM-based solution generation by explicitly prompting analogical transfer from structurally similar problems in different domains.
A technique for using analogical reasoning to bootstrap the search space of existing solution generation methods, achieving significant diversity and novelty improvements.
A framework for autonomous scientific discovery that combines analogical reasoning with LLMs to generate implementable solutions validated across multiple biomedical benchmarks.
idea_ch: 一种基于类比推理的开放式解决方案生成方法，通过识别跨领域问题之间的共享关系结构，映射并生成新颖解决方案。
一种缓解大语言模型在解决方案生成中模式坍塌的系统，通过显式引导模型从不同领域中结构相似的问题进行类比迁移。
一种利用类比推理扩展现有解决方案生成方法搜索空间的技术，显著提升解决方案的多样性和新颖性。
一种结合类比推理与大语言模型的自主科学发现框架，能够在多个生物医学基准上生成并验证可实现的解决方案。

title: Template-as-Ontology: Configurable Synthetic Data Infrastructure for Cross-Domain Manufacturing AI Validation
summary: LLarge language model (LLM)-based AI agents deployed in manufacturing environments require populated, schema-correct data for validation, yet production MES data is proprietary, privacy-encumbered, and vendor-specific. This paper introduces the Template-as-Ontology principle: a single Python configuration module (700-770 lines, 45 validated exports) serves simultaneously as the specification for a time-stepped manufacturing simulator and as the runtime domain schema for AI analytics tools, producing alignment by construction rather than integration. We formally define the domain template as a typed relational configuration schema and prove that structural alignment between simulation and tool layers is guaranteed by single-source consumption. A five-layer pipeline--simulation, PostgreSQL, CDC/Iceberg lakehouse, star schema, and 12 parameterized AI tools--generates causally coherent, MES-shaped data spanning 66 entity types across four operational domains mapped to ISA-95/IEC 62264. We validate the architecture with six industry templates (aerospace, pharma, automotive, electronics, beverages, warehousing) running on identical framework code. Calibration experiments (60 runs, 10 seeds per template) confirm parametric controllability: observed KPIs fall within configured ranges across all templates. A controlled hallucination experiment (72 tool invocations, Qwen3-32B) demonstrates that ontology-constrained parameters eliminate tool-parameter fabrication (0% constrained vs. 43% unconstrained hallucination rate for the evaluated model, Fisher's exact test p < 10^-12); the 0% constrained rate is an architectural guarantee that holds for any model. The framework provides a reusable data layer for discrete manufacturing AI validation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"模板即本体"原则，通过单一Python配置模块同时作为制造模拟器规范和AI分析工具运行时领域模式，从根本上消除仿真数据与AI工具之间的结构性偏差，实现零幻觉的数据生成架构。
AI.motivation: 制造环境中基于LLM的AI代理需要填充了正确模式的数据进行验证，但生产MES数据是专有的、涉及隐私且因供应商而异，缺乏可复用的标准化验证数据层。
AI.method: 提出Template-as-Ontology原则：一个Python配置模块同时作为时间步进模拟器的规范和AI分析工具的运行时领域模式。构建五层流水线（模拟器→PostgreSQL→CDC/Iceberg湖仓→星型模式→12个参数化AI工具），通过单一数据源消费保证结构对齐。涵盖66个实体类型、4个运营领域，映射到ISA-95/IEC 62264标准。
AI.result: 六个行业模板（航空航天、制药、汽车、电子、饮料、仓储）在相同框架代码上运行。校准实验（60次运行，每模板10个种子）确认参数可控性。幻觉控制实验（72次工具调用，Qwen3-32B）显示：本体约束参数实现0%工具参数捏造（无约束时为43%幻觉率，Fisher精确检验p<10^-12），且0%是任何模型都成立的架构性保证。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为离散制造AI验证提供了可复用的数据层，通过"构建即对齐"替代传统集成方式，从根本上解决了数据一致性问题。
idea_en: Template-as-Ontology principle: A single Python configuration module serving simultaneously as manufacturing simulator specification and runtime domain schema for AI analytics tools, ensuring structural alignment by construction rather than integration.

Five-layer simulation-to-AI pipeline architecture: simulator → PostgreSQL → CDC/Iceberg lakehouse → star schema → parameterized AI tools, generating causally coherent MES-shaped data spanning 66 entity types mapped to ISA-95/IEC 62264.

Ontology-constrained tool parameter method: Using domain template to constrain AI tool parameter generation, architecturally guaranteeing zero hallucination rate for tool-parameter fabrication regardless of the underlying model.
Cross-industry reusable manufacturing data framework: Single framework code generating validated MES-like data for aerospace, pharma, automotive, electronics, beverages, and warehousing domains.
Single-source consumption guarantee: Formal proof that structural alignment between simulation and tool layers is guaranteed when both consume from the same typed relational configuration schema.
idea_ch: 模板即本体原则：单一Python配置模块同时作为制造模拟器的规范和AI分析工具的运行时领域模式，通过构建而非集成方式保证结构对齐。
五层仿真到AI流水线架构：模拟器→PostgreSQL→CDC/Iceberg湖仓→星型模式→参数化AI工具，生成跨越66个实体类型、映射到ISA-95/IEC 62264标准的因果一致MES数据。
本体约束工具参数方法：使用领域模板约束AI工具参数生成，从架构层面保证零工具参数捏造幻觉率，且该保证不依赖于底层模型。
跨行业可复用制造数据框架：以相同框架代码为航空航天、制药、汽车、电子、饮料、仓储六个行业生成经过验证的MES数据。
单一数据源消费保证：形式化证明当仿真层和工具层从同一类型化关系配置模式消费数据时，两者之间的结构对齐被保证。

title: LatentRouter: Can We Choose the Right Multimodal Model Before Seeing Its Answer?
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have heterogeneous strengths across OCR, chart understanding, spatial reasoning, visual question answering, cost, and latency. Effective MLLM routing therefore requires more than estimating query difficulty: a router must match the multimodal requirements of the current image-question input with the capabilities of each candidate model. We propose LatentRouter, a router that formulates MLLM routing as counterfactual multimodal utility prediction. Given an image-question query, LatentRouter extracts learned multimodal routing capsules, represents each candidate MLLM with a model capability token, and performs latent communication between these states to estimate how each model would perform if selected. A distributional outcome head predicts model-specific counterfactual quality, while a bounded capsule correction refines close decisions without allowing residual signals to dominate the prediction. The resulting utility-based policy supports performance-oriented and performance-cost routing, and handles changing candidate pools through shared per-model scoring with availability masking. Experiments on MMR-Bench and VL-RouterBench show that LatentRouter outperforms fixed-model, feature-level, and learned-router baselines. Additional analyses show that the gains are strongest on multimodal task groups where model choice depends on visual, layout-sensitive, or reasoning-oriented requirements, and that latent communication is the main contributor to the improvement. The code is available at: https://github.com/LabRAI/LatentRouter.

AI.tldr: 提出LatentRouter，一种通过反事实多模态效用预测进行MLLM路由的方法，在MMR-Bench和VL-RouterBench上优于现有基线。
AI.motivation: 现有MLLM路由方法仅考虑查询难度，忽略了不同模型在多模态能力（OCR、图表理解、空间推理等）上的异构优势，需要更精细的路由策略。
AI.method: 1) 提取多模态路由胶囊（multimodal routing capsules）；2) 为每个候选模型分配模型能力令牌（model capability token）；3) 通过潜在通信（latent communication）估计各模型被选中后的反事实表现；4) 分布性结果头预测反事实质量；5) 有界胶囊校正（bounded capsule correction）优化边界决策。
AI.result: 在MMR-Bench和VL-RouterBench上超越固定模型、特征级和学习型路由基线，尤其在依赖视觉、布局或推理的任务组上增益最强。
AI.conclusion: 潜在通信机制是性能提升的主要贡献因素；该方法支持性能导向和性能-成本混合路由，且能通过共享评分与可用性掩码处理动态模型池。
idea_en: Counterfactual multimodal utility prediction framework for selecting the optimal MLLM per query, predicting model-specific performance via latent communication between routing capsules and model capability tokens.
Distributional outcome head that predicts counterfactual quality distributions instead of point estimates, enabling more nuanced model selection under uncertainty.
Bounded capsule correction mechanism that refines close routing decisions near decision boundaries without allowing residual signals to dominate the final prediction.

Model capability token representation that encodes each candidate MLLM's strengths into a learnable token, enabling shared per-model scoring and handling of changing model pools via availability masking.
idea_ch: 基于反事实多模态效用预测的MLLM路由框架：通过路由胶囊与模型能力令牌之间的潜在通信，预测每个候选模型被选中后的实际表现，从而选择最优模型。
分布性结果头（Distributional Outcome Head）：预测反事实质量的概率分布而非点估计，在不确定性下实现更精细的模型选择。
有界胶囊校正机制（Bounded Capsule Correction）：在决策边界附近精细校正路由决策，同时防止残差信号主导最终预测。
模型能力令牌表示（Model Capability Token）：将每个候选MLLM的能力编码为可学习令牌，通过共享评分和可用性掩码支持动态模型池的灵活切换。

title: Constraint-Data-Value-Maximization: Utilizing Data Attribution for Effective Data Pruning in Low-Data Environments
summary: Attributing model behavior to training data is an evolving research field. A common benchmark is data removal, which involves eliminating data instances with either low or high values, then assessing a model's performance trained on the modified dataset. Many existing studies leverage Shapley-based data values for this task. In this paper, we demonstrate that these data values are not optimally suited for pruning low-value data when only a limited amount of data remains. To address this limitation, we introduce the Constraint-Data-Value-Maximization (CDVM) approach, which effectively utilizes data attributions for pruning in low-data scenarios. By casting pruning as a constrained optimization that both maximizes total influence and penalizes excessive per-test contributions, CDVM delivers robust performance when only a small fraction of the data is retained. On the OpenDataVal benchmark, CDVM shows strong performance and competitive runtime.

AI.tldr: 本文发现Shapley值在低数据量剪枝场景下表现不佳，提出约束数据值最大化（CDVM）方法，通过将剪枝建模为约束优化问题，在保留少量数据时显著提升性能。
AI.motivation: 现有基于Shapley的数据价值方法在低数据量剪枝场景下表现不佳，需要更优的数据归属利用方法。
AI.method: 提出约束数据值最大化（CDVM）方法，将剪枝问题建模为约束优化：最大化总影响的同时，惩罚过度的每个测试样本贡献，从而在仅保留少量数据时实现鲁棒性能。
AI.result: 在OpenDataVal基准测试上，CDVM方法展现出强大的性能和有竞争力的运行时间。
AI.conclusion: CDVM方法有效解决了Shapley值在低数据量场景下的局限性，为数据剪枝提供了更优的数据归属利用方案。
idea_en: A Constraint-Data-Value-Maximization (CDVM) method for data pruning that formulates pruning as a constrained optimization problem balancing total influence maximization and per-test contribution penalties.
A data attribution technique specifically optimized for low-data scenarios where only a small fraction of original training data is retained.
A constrained optimization framework that combines influence maximization with per-test contribution regularization for robust data pruning.
idea_ch: 约束数据值最大化（CDVM）方法：将数据剪枝建模为约束优化问题，同时最大化总影响并惩罚过度测试样本贡献。
面向低数据场景的数据归属技术：专为仅保留少量训练数据的情况优化，克服Shapley值在低数据量下的局限性。
结合影响最大化与逐测试贡献正则化的剪枝框架：通过约束优化实现数据剪枝的鲁棒性能。

title: Rethinking Evaluation for LLM Hallucination Detection: A Desiderata, A New RAG-based Benchmark, New Insights
summary: Hallucination, broadly referring to unfaithful, fabricated, or inconsistent content generated by LLMs, has wide-ranging implications. Therefore, a large body of effort has been devoted to detecting LLM hallucinations, as well as designing benchmark datasets for evaluating these detectors. In this work, we first establish a desiderata of properties for hallucination detection benchmarks (HDBs) to exhibit for effective evaluation. A critical look at existing HDBs through the lens of our desiderata reveals that none of them exhibits all the properties. We identify two largest gaps: (1) RAG-based grounded benchmarks with long context are severely lacking (partly because length impedes human annotation); and (2) Existing benchmarks do not make available realistic label noise for stress-testing detectors although real-world use-cases often grapple with label noise due to human or automated/weak annotation. To close these gaps, we build and open-source a new RAG-based HDB called T RIVIA+ that underwent a rigorous human annotation process. Notably, our benchmark exhibits all desirable properties including (1) T RIVIA+ contains samples with the longest context in the literature; and (2) we design and share four sets of noisy labels with different, both sample-dependent and sampleindependent, noise schemes. Finally, we perform experiments on RAG-based HDBs, including our T RIVIA+, using popular SOTA detectors that reveal new insights: (i) ample room remains for current detectors to reach the performance ceiling on RAG-based HDBs, (ii) the basic LLM-as-a-Judge baseline performs competitively, and (iii) label noise hinders detection performance. We expect that our findings, along with our proposed benchmark 1 , will motivate and foster needed research on hallucination detection for RAG-based tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了幻觉检测基准（HDB）的理想属性集，指出现有基准缺乏长上下文的RAG基准和真实标签噪声。作者构建了TRIVIA+基准，具有最长上下文和四种噪声标签方案，实验表明现有检测器仍有提升空间。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM幻觉检测基准存在两大缺陷：缺乏基于RAG的长上下文基准，且缺少用于压力测试的标签噪声。作者希望填补这些空白，建立更有效的评估基准。
AI.method: 先建立幻觉检测基准的理想属性框架，分析现有基准不足；然后构建TRIVIA+基准，包含严格人工标注和最长上下文；设计四种噪声标签方案（样本依赖和样本独立）；用SOTA检测器在RAG基准上进行实验评估。
AI.result: TRIVIA+具有文献中最长的上下文；现有检测器在RAG基准上远未达到性能天花板；基础LLM-as-a-Judge方法表现有竞争力；标签噪声会损害检测性能。
AI.conclusion: 现有RAG幻觉检测仍存较大改进空间，TRIVIA+基准为相关研究提供了更全面的评估平台。
idea_en: A system for generating RAG-based hallucination detection benchmarks with longest context length through rigorous human annotation process
A method for designing multiple label noise schemes (both sample-dependent and sample-independent) for stress-testing hallucination detectors
A desiderata-based evaluation framework for assessing the quality of hallucination detection benchmarks
A technique for creating realistic noisy labels in hallucination detection datasets to simulate real-world annotation conditions
idea_ch: 一种通过严格人工标注流程生成具有最长上下文长度的RAG幻觉检测基准的系统
一种设计多种标签噪声方案（包括样本依赖和样本独立）来压力测试幻觉检测器的方法
一种基于理想属性框架的幻觉检测基准质量评估方法
一种在幻觉检测数据集中生成真实噪声标签以模拟真实世界标注条件的技术

title: CPEMH: An Agentic Framework for Prompt-Driven Behavior Evaluation and Assurance in Foundation-Model Systems for Mental Health Screening
comment: 4 pages, 2 figures. Accepted at the AGENT 2026 Workshop (ICSE 2026)
summary: This paper presents CPEMH, an agentic framework designed to evaluate prompt-driven behavior in foundation-model systems operating on transcript-based datasets for mental-health screening. CPEMH serves as an engineering methodology for behavioral assurance in large-scale language systems, introducing an orchestrated architecture that autonomously performs the design, evaluation, and selection of prompt strategies, enabling systematic control of behavioral variability across contexts. Its modular agentic design, combining orchestrator, inference, and evaluation agents, ensures traceability, reproducibility, and robustness throughout the prompting lifecycle. A case study on automated depression screening from interview transcripts demonstrates the framework's capacity to stabilize and audit foundation-model behavior in conversational and clinically sensitive domains. Lessons learned emphasize the role of modular orchestration in behavioral assurance, the prioritization of stability over architectural complexity, and the integration of F1, bias, and robustness as core acceptance criteria.

AI.tldr: CPEMH是一个用于评估基础模型在心理健康筛查中提示驱动行为的智能体框架，通过模块化编排架构实现提示策略的自主设计、评估和选择，确保行为稳定性与可审计性。
AI.motivation: 大规模语言系统在心理健康筛查等敏感场景中存在行为变异性和不可控问题，缺乏系统化的行为保障方法论。
AI.method: 提出CPEMH框架，采用编排器、推理和评估三种智能体组成的模块化架构，自主完成提示策略的设计、评估和选择，实现跨上下文的系统性行为控制。
AI.result: 在自动抑郁症筛查案例中验证了框架稳定和审计基础模型行为的能力，强调模块化编排、稳定性优先于架构复杂度、以及F1/偏倚/鲁棒性作为核心验收标准。
AI.conclusion: 模块化编排是行为保障的关键，稳定性比架构复杂性更重要，F1分数、偏倚和鲁棒性应作为核心验收标准。
idea_en: A multi-agent orchestrated architecture (orchestrator, inference, evaluation agents) for autonomous prompt strategy design, evaluation, and selection in foundation-model systems.
A behavior assurance methodology that systematically controls prompt-driven behavioral variability across different conversational contexts using modular agentic design.
Integration of F1 score, bias metrics, and robustness checks as a unified acceptance criteria framework for behavioral assurance in clinical NLP systems.
A traceable and reproducible prompting lifecycle management system for transcript-based mental health screening applications.
idea_ch: 一种用于基础模型系统的多智能体编排架构（编排器、推理、评估智能体），能够自主完成提示策略的设计、评估和选择。
一种通过模块化智能体设计系统性控制跨对话上下文的提示驱动行为变异性的行为保障方法。
将F1分数、偏倚指标和鲁棒性检查整合为临床NLP系统行为保障的统一验收标准框架。
一种基于转录数据的心理健康筛查应用的可追溯、可复现的提示生命周期管理系统。

title: CVEvolve: Autonomous Algorithm Discovery for Unstructured Scientific Data Processing
summary: Scientific data processing often requires task-specific algorithms or AI models, creating a barrier for domain scientists who need to analyze their data but may not have extensive computing or image-processing expertise. This barrier is especially pronounced when data are noisy, have a high dynamic range, are sparsely labeled, or are only loosely specified. We introduce CVEvolve, an autonomous agentic harness with a zero-code interface for scientific data-processing algorithm discovery. CVEvolve combines a multi-round search strategy with tools for code execution, evaluation implementation, history management, holdout testing, and optional inspection of scientific data and visual outputs. The search alternates between discovery and improvement actions, and uses lineage-aware stochastic candidate sampling to balance exploration and exploitation. We demonstrate CVEvolve on x-ray fluorescence microscopy image registration, Bragg peak detection, and high-energy diffraction microscopy image segmentation. Across these tasks, CVEvolve discovers algorithms that improve over baseline methods, while holdout test tracking helps identify candidates that generalize better than later over-optimized alternatives. These results show that zero-code, autonomous LLM-powered algorithm development can help domain scientists turn unstructured scientific image data into practical algorithms and downstream scientific discoveries.

AI.tldr: CVEvolve是一个零代码接口的自主智能体框架，结合多轮搜索策略与代码执行、评估实现、历史管理、保留测试等工具，用于科学数据处理算法发现。在X射线荧光显微镜图像配准、布拉格峰检测和高能衍射显微镜图像分割等任务中，CVEvolve发现的算法优于基线方法，表明零代码、自主LLM驱动的算法开发能帮助领域科学家将非结构化科学图像数据转化为实用算法。
AI.motivation: 传统科学数据处理需要特定算法或AI模型专业知识，对缺乏计算或图像处理专长但需要分析数据的领域科学家构成障碍，尤其当数据噪声大、动态范围高、标签稀疏或规格松散时。
AI.method: CVEvolve采用零代码接口的自主智能体框架，结合多轮搜索策略（交替进行发现和改进动作）、代码执行工具、评估实现、历史管理、保留测试、科学数据与视觉输出检查，以及基于谱系感知的随机候选采样，在探索与利用间取得平衡。
AI.result: 在X射线荧光显微镜图像配准、布拉格峰检测和高能衍射显微镜图像分割三项任务中，CVEvolve发现算法均优于基线方法，且保留测试跟踪有助于识别泛化能力更好的候选方案，避免后期过度优化。
AI.conclusion: 零代码、自主LLM驱动的算法开发方法可帮助领域科学家将非结构化科学图像数据转化为实用算法，推动下游科学发现。
idea_en: A zero-code autonomous agentic harness (CVEvolve) that uses LLM-powered multi-round search for scientific data-processing algorithm discovery without requiring programming expertise.
A lineage-aware stochastic candidate sampling method that balances exploration and exploitation in algorithm search by tracking candidate history and relationships.
A multi-round search strategy that alternates between discovery actions (generating new algorithms) and improvement actions (refining existing ones) for algorithmic optimization.
An integrated holdout test tracking mechanism that identifies candidates with better generalization by comparing performance against over-optimized alternatives.
A zero-code interface combining code execution, evaluation implementation, history management, and visual output inspection tools for domain scientists.
idea_ch: CVEvolve：一种零代码自主智能体框架，利用LLM驱动的多轮搜索策略进行科学数据处理算法发现，无需编程专业知识。
基于谱系感知的随机候选采样方法：通过跟踪候选算法的历史和关系信息，在算法搜索中平衡探索与利用。
多轮交替搜索策略：在发现动作（生成新算法）和改进动作（优化现有算法）之间交替进行，实现算法迭代优化。
集成保留测试跟踪机制：通过比较候选算法与过度优化替代方案的性能，识别泛化能力更优的算法。
零代码接口集成工具套件：将代码执行、评估实现、历史管理和视觉输出检查功能整合为一体，降低领域科学家使用门槛。

title: Causal Bias Detection in Generative Artifical Intelligence
summary: Automated systems built on artificial intelligence (AI) are increasingly deployed across high-stakes domains, raising critical concerns about fairness and the perpetuation of demographic disparities that exist in the world. In this context, causal inference provides a principled framework for reasoning about fairness, as it links observed disparities to underlying mechanisms and aligns naturally with human intuition and legal notions of discrimination. Prior work on causal fairness primarily focuses on the standard machine learning setting, where a decision-maker constructs a single predictive mechanism $f_{\widehat Y}$ for an outcome variable $Y$, while inheriting the causal mechanisms of all other covariates from the real world. The generative AI setting, however, is markedly more complex: generative models can sample from arbitrary conditionals over any set of variables, implicitly constructing their own beliefs about all causal mechanisms rather than learning a single predictive function. This fundamental difference requires new developments in causal fairness methodology. We formalize the problem of causal fairness in generative AI and unify it with the standard ML setting under a common theoretical framework. We then derive new causal decomposition results that enable granular quantification of fairness impacts along both (a) different causal pathways and (b) the replacement of real-world mechanisms by the generative model's mechanisms. We establish identification conditions and introduce efficient estimators for causal quantities of interest, and demonstrate the value of our methodology by analyzing race and gender bias in large language models across different datasets.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了生成式AI场景下的因果公平性形式化框架，将标准机器学习与生成式AI的公平性问题统一，推导了新的因果分解方法以量化不同因果路径和机制替换带来的公平性影响，并在大语言模型中验证了种族和性别偏见分析的有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有的因果公平性研究主要针对标准机器学习场景（学习单一预测函数），而生成式AI能够从任意条件分布采样，隐式构建所有因果机制，需要全新的公平性方法论。
AI.method: 形式化生成式AI中的因果公平性问题，统一标准ML和生成式AI的公平性理论框架；推导新的因果分解方法，量化不同因果路径和生成模型替换真实世界机制带来的公平性影响；建立识别条件并提出高效估计量。
AI.result: 在多个数据集上分析了大语言模型中的种族和性别偏见，验证了所提方法论的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 生成式AI的公平性问题需要不同于标准ML的因果方法论，本文提出的框架能够细粒度地量化不同因果路径和机制替换带来的公平性影响。
idea_en: A causal fairness decomposition method for generative AI that separates fairness impacts along different causal pathways and quantifies the effect of replacing real-world causal mechanisms with generative model's mechanisms.
A unified theoretical framework that bridges causal fairness in standard machine learning and generative AI settings, enabling cross-setting fairness analysis.
Identification conditions and efficient estimators for causal fairness quantities specifically designed for generative models, enabling practical bias quantification in large language models.
idea_ch: 一种生成式AI的因果公平性分解方法，能够沿着不同因果路径分离公平性影响，并量化生成模型替换真实世界因果机制的效果
一种统一的理论框架，桥接标准机器学习与生成式AI场景下的因果公平性，支持跨场景的公平性分析
专为生成模型设计的因果公平性量化识别条件与高效估计量，能够在大语言模型中实现实际的偏见量化分析

title: Causal Algorithmic Recourse: Foundations and Methods
summary: The trustworthiness of AI decision-making systems is increasingly important. A key feature of such systems is the ability to provide recommendations for how an individual may reverse a negative decision, a problem known as algorithmic recourse. Existing approaches treat recourse outcomes as counterfactuals of a fixed unit, ignoring that real-world recourse involves repeated decisions on the same individual under possibly different latent conditions. We develop a causal framework that models recourse as a process over pre- and post-intervention outcomes, allowing for partial stability and resampling of latent variables. We introduce post-recourse stability conditions that enable reasoning about recourse from observational data alone, and develop a copula-based algorithm for inferring the effects of recourse under these conditions. For settings where paired observations of the same individual before and after intervention are available (called recourse data), we develop methods for inferring copula parameters and performing goodness-of-fit testing. When the copula model is rejected, we provide a distribution-free algorithm for learning recourse effects directly from recourse data. We demonstrate the value of the proposed methods on real and semi-synthetic datasets.

AI.tldr: 提出因果框架建模算法追责（algorithmic recourse）为重复决策过程，引入追责后稳定性条件，开发基于copula的算法从观测数据推断追责效果。
AI.motivation: 现有追责方法将结果视为固定个体的反事实，忽略现实世界中追责涉及同一个体在不同潜在条件下的重复决策。
AI.method: 建立因果框架将追责建模为干预前/后的过程，允许部分稳定性和潜在变量重采样；引入追责后稳定性条件；开发基于copula的推断算法；针对配对追责数据提出copula参数推断和拟合优度检验方法；当copula模型被拒绝时提供无分布算法。
AI.result: 在真实和半合成数据集上验证了所提方法的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 通过因果建模和copula方法，能从观测数据推断追责效果，填补了现有追责理论中忽略重复决策动态的空白。
idea_en: A causal framework for algorithmic recourse that models recourse as a process over pre- and post-intervention outcomes with partial stability and resampling of latent variables.
Post-recourse stability conditions enabling inference of recourse effects from observational data alone.
A copula-based algorithm for inferring the effects of recourse under post-recourse stability conditions.
Methods for inferring copula parameters and performing goodness-of-fit testing using paired recourse data (before/after intervention on same individual).
A distribution-free algorithm for learning recourse effects directly from recourse data when copula model is rejected.
idea_ch: 一种将算法追责建模为干预前后结果过程并允许部分稳定性和潜在变量重采样的因果框架
追责后稳定性条件，使得仅从观测数据即可推断追责效果
基于copula的算法，在追责后稳定性条件下推断追责效果
利用同一个体干预前后的配对追责数据进行copula参数推断和拟合优度检验的方法
当copula模型被拒绝时，直接从追责数据学习追责效果的无分布算法

title: LLM-X: A Scalable Negotiation-Oriented Exchange for Communication Among Personal LLM Agents
comment: 8 pages, 7 figures, accepted at AGENT 2026 Workshop, co-located with ICSE 2026
summary: We propose a personal-LLM exchange (LLM-X), a scalable negotiation-oriented environment that enables direct, structured communication across populations of personal agents (LLMs), each representing an individual user. Unlike existing tool-centric protocols that focus on agent-API interaction, LLM-X introduces a message bus and routing substrate for LLM-to-LLM coordination with guarantees around schema validity and policy enforcement. We contribute: (1) an architecture for LLM-X comprising federated gateways, topic-based routing, and policy enforcement; (2) a typed message protocol supporting capability negotiation and contract-net-style coordination; and (3) the first empirical evaluation of LLM-based multi-agent negotiation at scale. Experiments span 5, 9, and 12 agents, under distinct negotiation policies (Low, Medium, High), and across both short-run (minutes) and long-run (2h, 12h) load conditions. Results highlight clear policy-performance trade-offs: stricter policies improve robustness and fairness but increase latencies and message volume. Extended runs confirm that LLM-X remains stable under sustained load, with bounded latency drift.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种个人LLM交换系统(LLM-X)，通过消息总线和路由机制实现大规模个人代理(LLM)之间的结构化协商通信，并进行了多智能体协商实验验证。
AI.motivation: 现有工具中心协议聚焦于代理-API交互，缺乏支持个人LLM之间直接、结构化通信的可扩展协商环境。
AI.method: 设计包含联邦网关、主题路由和策略执行的LLM-X架构；提出支持能力协商和合同网协调的类型化消息协议；在5/9/12个代理规模下进行不同策略和负载条件的实验评估。
AI.result: 严格策略提高鲁棒性和公平性但增加延迟和消息量；系统在持续负载下保持稳定，延迟漂移有界。
AI.conclusion: LLM-X实现了LLM间直接协商通信的可扩展架构，验证了策略-性能权衡，具有实际部署可行性。
idea_en: A federated gateway architecture for LLM-to-LLM coordination with topic-based routing and policy enforcement
A typed message protocol supporting capability negotiation and contract-net-style coordination for multi-agent systems
A message bus and routing substrate for direct structured communication between personal LLM agents with schema validity and policy guarantees
A scalable negotiation-oriented environment enabling policy-performance trade-off optimization across different negotiation strategies
idea_ch: 基于联邦网关的LLM间协调架构，结合主题路由与策略执行机制，实现跨个人代理的结构化通信
支持能力协商与合同网式协调的类型化消息协议，为多智能体系统提供标准化协商通信接口
面向个人LLM代理的消息总线与路由基础设施，具备模式验证和策略保障功能
可扩展的协商导向环境，支持不同协商策略下的策略-性能权衡优化方法

title: Revisiting Privacy Preservation in Brain-Computer Interfaces: Conceptual Boundaries, Risk Pathways, and a Protection-Strength Grading Framework
summary: Brain-computer interfaces (BCIs) are moving rapidly from laboratory research into clinical, edge, and real-world settings. Under ISO/IEC 8663:2025, a BCI is a direct communication link between central nervous system activity and external software or hardware systems. This link expands privacy risk beyond raw neural-signal leakage: neural data, derived representations, model assets, and decoded outputs can be re-associated with individuals across collection, transmission, storage, training, inference, and feedback, or used to infer information beyond what a task requires. Starting from the general BCI paradigm, this review deffnes privacy-protection boundaries, protection objects, and the relationship between user data privacy and model privacy within a shared risk pathway. It then proposes a three-dimensional framework - protection object, lifecycle stage, and dominant protection-strength level - to classify existing work into four levels of protection strength. Finally, mental privacy and neuroethical risks are treated as open issues, emphasizing that BCI privacy protection should not only obscure data but also disentangle task-irrelevant sensitive information while preserving downstream utility. Keywords: Brain-computer interface, Neural data privacy, User data privacy, Model privacy, Disentanglement of task-irrelevant sensitive information, Protection-strength grading, Neuroethical risks

AI.tldr: 本文综述了脑机接口（BCI）在现实应用中面临的隐私风险，提出了保护对象、生命周期阶段和保护强度等级的三维隐私保护框架，并强调了任务无关敏感信息解缠与神经伦理风险等开放问题。
AI.motivation: 随着BCI从实验室走向临床和现实场景，神经数据、衍生表征、模型资产和解码输出等面临严重的隐私泄露风险，现有保护方案缺乏系统性框架，亟需从技术、伦理和标准层面构建全面隐私保护体系。
AI.method: 从通用BCI范式出发，定义了隐私保护边界与保护对象，梳理了用户数据隐私与模型隐私在共享风险路径中的关系；提出了三维分类框架（保护对象×生命周期阶段×保护强度等级），将现有工作划分为四个保护强度级别。
AI.result: 构建了系统化的BCI隐私保护分类框架，实现了对不同保护技术和方案的强度分级，揭示了现有方法在解缠任务无关敏感信息方面的不足。
AI.conclusion: BCI隐私保护不仅要模糊数据，还需在保持下游任务效用的同时解缠任务无关的敏感信息；心理隐私和神经伦理风险是未来关键开放问题。
idea_en: A three-dimensional privacy protection framework for BCI systems that classifies protection objects, lifecycle stages, and protection-strength levels to systematically assess and implement privacy safeguards.
A task-irrelevant sensitive information disentanglement method for neural data that preserves downstream task utility while removing privacy-sensitive features.
A protection-strength grading mechanism for BCI privacy that defines four levels of protection based on the combination of protection object, lifecycle stage, and strength requirements.
A lifecycle-aware privacy protection architecture for BCI that dynamically adjusts protection mechanisms across data collection, transmission, storage, training, inference, and feedback stages.

A neural data privacy risk pathway model that maps the flow of raw neural signals, derived representations, model assets, and decoded outputs across the BCI pipeline to identify re-identification vulnerabilities.
idea_ch: 一种面向BCI系统的三维隐私保护框架，通过对保护对象、生命周期阶段和保护强度等级进行分类，实现对隐私保护措施的系统性评估与实施
一种神经数据中任务无关敏感信息的解缠方法，在去除隐私敏感特征的同时保持下游任务效用
一种BCI隐私保护强度分级机制，基于保护对象、生命周期阶段和强度要求的组合，定义四个保护等级
一种面向BCI全生命周期的隐私保护架构，在数据采集、传输、存储、训练、推理和反馈等阶段动态调整保护机制
一种神经数据隐私风险路径模型，通过映射原始神经信号、衍生表征、模型资产和解码输出在BCI管道中的流动，识别重识别漏洞

title: Transformer Interpretability from Perspective of Attention and Gradient
summary: Although researchers' attention is more focused on the performance of Transformer models, the interpretation of Transformer can never be ignored. Gradient is widely utilized in Transformer interpretation. From the perspective of attention and gradient, we conduct an in-depth study of Transformer interpretation and propose a method to achieve it by guiding the gradient direction, or more precisely, the attention direction. The method enables more comprehensive interpretation of feature regions, offers detail interpretation, and helps to better understand Transformer mechanism. Leveraging the difference in how Vision Transformer (ViT) and humans perceive images, we alter the class of an image in a way that is almost imperceptible to the human eye. This class rewriting phenomenon may potentially pose security risks in certain scenarios.

AI.tldr: 本文从梯度和注意力角度研究Transformer的可解释性，提出通过引导梯度方向（即注意力方向）来实现对特征区域的更全面、细致解释，并发现利用ViT与人类视觉感知差异可实现人眼几乎不可察觉的类别改写现象，可能带来安全隐患。
AI.motivation: 当前研究多聚焦于Transformer模型性能，但其可解释性研究相对滞后；梯度被广泛用于Transformer解释，但现有方法存在解释不全面、缺乏细节等问题。
AI.method: 从注意力与梯度角度深入研究，提出通过引导梯度方向（更精确地说是注意力方向）来实现Transformer解释的方法。
AI.result: 该方法能够实现更全面的特征区域解释，提供细节层面的解释，并有助于更好地理解Transformer机制。同时发现利用ViT与人类视觉感知差异可实现人眼几乎不可察觉的类别改写。
AI.conclusion: 引导梯度方向（注意力方向）是一种有效的Transformer解释方法，但类别改写现象可能在某些场景下带来安全风险。
idea_en: A method for interpreting Transformer models by guiding gradient direction (attention direction) to achieve comprehensive and detailed interpretation of feature regions.
A class rewriting technique that exploits the difference between Vision Transformer (ViT) and human visual perception to alter image class imperceptibly to the human eye.
A gradient-guided attention direction mechanism for more detailed and comprehensive understanding of Transformer internal mechanisms.
idea_ch: 一种通过引导梯度方向（注意力方向）实现Transformer模型可解释性的方法，能够对特征区域进行全面而细致的解释。
一种利用Vision Transformer（ViT）与人类视觉感知差异，实现人眼几乎不可察觉的类别改写技术，该技术可在不改变人类视觉判断的情况下改变模型分类结果。
一种基于梯度引导的注意力方向机制，用于更详细、更全面地理解Transformer内部工作原理和决策过程。

title: AcuityBench: Evaluating Clinical Acuity Identification and Uncertainty Alignment
comment: 41 pages, 5 figures. Preprint under review for the Track on Evaluations and Datasets at NeurIPS 2026
summary: We introduce AcuityBench, a benchmark for evaluating whether language models identify the appropriate urgency of care from user medical presentations. Existing health benchmarks emphasize medical question answering, broad health interactions, or narrow workflow-specific triage tasks, but they do not offer a unified evaluation of acuity identification across these settings. AcuityBench addresses this gap by harmonizing five public datasets spanning user conversations, online forum posts, clinical vignettes, and patient portal messages under a shared four-level acuity framework ranging from home monitoring to immediate emergency care. The benchmark contains 914 cases, including 697 consensus cases for standard accuracy evaluation and 217 physician-confirmed ambiguous cases for uncertainty-aware evaluation. It supports two complementary task formats: explicit four-way classification in a QA setting, and free-form conversational responses evaluated with a rubric-based judge anchored to the same framework. Across 12 frontier proprietary and open-weight models, we find substantial variation in clear-case acuity accuracy and error direction. Comparing task formats reveals a systematic tradeoff: conversational responses reduce over-triage but increase under-triage relative to QA, especially in higher-acuity cases. In ambiguous cases, no model closely matches the distribution of physician judgments, and model predictions are more concentrated than expert clinical uncertainty. We also compare expert and model adjudication on a subset of maximally ambiguous cases, using those cases to examine the role of clinical uncertainty in label disagreement. Together, these results position acuity identification as a distinct safety-critical capability and show that AcuityBench enables systematic comparison and stress-testing of how well models guide users to the right level of care in real-world health use.

AI.tldr: AcuityBench是一个用于评估语言模型从用户医疗表述中识别适当护理紧急程度的基准测试，包含5个公开数据集、914个案例，支持分类和对话两种任务格式。对12个前沿模型的测试显示，模型在紧急程度识别上存在显著差异和系统性权衡。
AI.motivation: 现有健康基准侧重于医学问答、广义健康交互或狭窄的特定工作流程分诊任务，缺乏一个统一的紧急程度识别评估框架，无法全面评估模型在不同场景下识别医疗护理紧急程度的能力。
AI.method: AcuityBench整合了5个公开数据集（涵盖用户对话、在线论坛帖子、临床案例和患者门户消息），统一采用四级紧急程度框架（从家庭监测到立即紧急护理）。包含914个案例：697个共识案例用于标准准确率评估，217个医生确认的模糊案例用于不确定性感知评估。支持两种任务格式：QA设置下的明确四分类，以及基于相同框架的评分评估的自由格式对话响应。
AI.result: 12个前沿模型在清晰案例的紧急程度准确性和错误方向上存在显著差异。对话格式相比QA格式减少了过度分诊但增加了分诊不足，尤其是在高紧急程度案例中。在模糊案例中，没有模型能紧密匹配医生判断的分布，模型预测比专家临床不确定性更加集中。
AI.conclusion: 紧急程度识别是一项独特的安全关键能力，AcuityBench能够系统比较和压力测试模型在真实健康使用场景中引导用户到适当护理水平的能力。
idea_en: A unified multi-source acuity classification framework that harmonizes heterogeneous medical datasets (user conversations, forum posts, clinical vignettes, portal messages) under a shared four-level urgency taxonomy for evaluating language model triage capabilities.
A dual-task evaluation methodology combining explicit four-way classification (QA format) with rubric-based free-form conversational response assessment for measuring model acuity identification.
An uncertainty-aware evaluation approach using physician-confirmed ambiguous cases to compare model predictions against expert clinical uncertainty distributions.

A systematic error direction analysis method for triage tasks that distinguishes between over-triage (unnecessary escalation) and under-triage (dangerous downgrading) in medical urgency classification.
A rubric-based judge system for evaluating free-form conversational triage responses anchored to a standardized four-level acuity framework.
idea_ch: 一种统一的多源紧急程度分类框架，将异构医疗数据集（用户对话、论坛帖子、临床案例、患者门户消息）协调到共享的四级紧急程度分类体系中，用于评估语言模型的分诊能力。
一种双任务评估方法，结合明确的四分类（QA格式）和基于评分标准的自由格式对话响应评估，用于测量模型紧急程度识别能力。
一种不确定性感知评估方法，使用医生确认的模糊案例来比较模型预测与专家临床不确定性分布。
一种医疗分诊任务的系统性错误方向分析方法，区分过度分诊（不必要的升级）和分诊不足（危险的降级）在医疗紧急程度分类中的表现。
一种基于评分标准的判断系统，用于评估锚定在标准化四级紧急程度框架上的自由格式对话式分诊响应。

title: Attributing Emergence in Million-Agent Systems
summary: Large language models (LLMs) can simulate human-like reasoning and decision-making in individual agents. LLM-powered multi-agent systems (MAS) combine such agents to simulate population-scale social phenomena such as polarization, information cascades, and market panics. Such studies require attributing macro emergence to individual agents, but existing axiomatic methods scale combinatorially in $N$ and have been confined to $N \lesssim 10^3$, while the phenomena they explain occur at $N \geq 10^6$. We address this gap by adapting Aumann--Shapley path-integral attribution to LLM-powered MAS at million-agent scale; the resulting method satisfies all four axioms, runs four to five orders of magnitude faster than sampled Shapley on the same hardware. We use this method to test the scale gap empirically: across 14 days of public Bluesky data ($1{,}671{,}587$ active users), we compute the attribution at both full scale and the visibility-biased $N = 10^2$ convenience sample used by small-scale studies, and the two disagree structurally. At full scale the long tail and middle tier jointly carry the majority; the biased small panel attributes almost everything to a few high-follower accounts. We then prove that under any nonlinear macro indicator the disagreement cannot be reduced by post-hoc rescaling: an Attribution Scaling Bias theorem shows that no global rescaling factor can reconcile small-scale and full-scale attribution. Full-scale attribution is therefore not a methodological choice but a theoretical requirement for any nonlinear macro indicator.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于Aumann-Shapley路径积分归因的方法，用于百万级LLM驱动的多智能体系统，解决了现有公理方法在规模上的局限性，并通过Bluesky数据实证证明了大规模归因的必要性。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM驱动的多智能体系统研究将社会现象归因于个体时，公理方法计算复杂度随智能体数量N呈组合爆炸，仅限于N≤10³规模，而实际现象发生在N≥10⁶规模，存在规模鸿沟。
AI.method: 将Aumann-Shapley路径积分归因方法适配到LLM驱动的多智能体系统中，实现百万级规模的归因计算；同时在Bluesky平台上对1,671,587名活跃用户进行14天的实证验证。
AI.result: 提出的方法满足所有四条公理，运行速度比采样Shapley快4-5个数量级。全尺度归因与小规模便利样本（N=10²）的归因结果存在结构性分歧：全尺度下长尾和中层用户共同承担主要归因，而小规模样本将几乎全部归因归给少数高粉丝账户。
AI.conclusion: 证明了归因缩放偏差定理：对于任何非线性宏观指标，无法通过后验重新缩放来调和全尺度与小规模归因结果。因此，全尺度归因不是方法选择问题，而是非线性宏观指标的理论要求。
idea_en: A method for attributing macro-level emergent phenomena to individual agents in million-scale LLM-powered multi-agent systems using Aumann-Shapley path-integral attribution, achieving 4-5 orders of magnitude speedup over sampled Shapley.
An Attribution Scaling Bias theorem proving that no global rescaling factor can reconcile small-scale and full-scale attribution for any nonlinear macro indicator.

A system for detecting structural disagreement between full-scale and biased small-panel attributions in social media networks, specifically identifying the long-tail and middle-tier vs. high-follower account attribution divergence.

A path-integral based attribution method satisfying all four cooperative game theory axioms (efficiency, symmetry, linearity, dummy player) adapted for LLM-based multi-agent simulations at population scale.
idea_ch: 一种基于Aumann-Shapley路径积分归因的方法，用于百万级LLM驱动的多智能体系统中将宏观涌现现象归因到个体智能体，相比采样Shapley实现4-5个数量级的加速。
归因缩放偏差定理：证明了对于任何非线性宏观指标，不存在全局重新缩放因子能够调和全尺度与小规模归因结果。
一种检测社交媒体网络中全尺度归因与有偏小样本归因之间结构性分歧的系统，特别识别长尾和中层用户与高粉丝账户之间的归因差异。
一种满足所有四条合作博弈论公理（效率、对称性、线性、虚拟玩家）的路径积分归因方法，专为人口规模的LLM多智能体仿真适配。

title: What Do EEG Foundation Models Capture from Human Brain Signals?
summary: Clinical electroencephalogram (EEG) analysis rests on a hand-crafted feature catalog refined over decades, \emph{e.g.,} band power, connectivity, complexity, and more. Modern EEG foundation models bypass this catalog, learn directly from raw signals via self-supervised pretraining, and match or outperform feature-engineered baselines on most clinical benchmarks. Whether the two representations align is an open question, which we decompose into three sub-questions: \emph{what does the model learn}, \emph{what does the model use}, and \emph{how much can be explained}. We answer them with layer-wise ridge probing, LEACE-style cross-covariance subspace erasure, and a transparent classifier benchmarked against a random-feature baseline. The audit covers three foundation models (CSBrain, CBraMod, LaBraM), five clinical tasks (MDD, Stress, ISRUC-Sleep, TUSL, Siena), and a 6-family 63-feature lexicon. Of the $945$ (model, task, feature) units, $648$ ($68.6\%$) are representation-causal and $199$ ($21.1\%$) are encoded-only. Across tasks, $50$ features qualify as universal candidates with strong support (all three architectures RC) in two or more tasks. Frequency-domain features dominate, but the other five families each contribute substantial causal mass. Confirmed features recover, on average, $79.3\%$ of the foundation model's advantage over the random baseline, with a clean task gradient (MDD $\approx 0.99$ down to Stress $\approx 0.56$): tasks near ceiling are almost fully recovered by the lexicon, while harder tasks leave a non-trivial residual that pinpoints a concrete target for future concept discovery.

AI.tldr: 本文系统性地审计了EEG基础模型学到的特征表示是否与传统手工特征目录（如频带功率、连接性、复杂性等）一致。通过层状岭回归探测、LEACE跨协方差子空间擦除和透明分类器基准测试，分析了三个基础模型、五个临床任务和63个特征。结果发现68.6%的（模型、任务、特征）单元是表示因果性的，50个特征在不同任务中具有通用性，频域特征占主导但其他家族也贡献显著。确认的特征平均恢复了基础模型相对于随机基线79.3%的优势。
AI.motivation: 现代EEG基础模型通过自监督预训练直接从原始信号学习，在临床基准上匹配或超越传统特征工程方法，但两者的表示是否对齐尚不清楚。本文旨在回答三个子问题：模型学到了什么、模型使用了什么、以及多少可以被解释。
AI.method: 采用层状岭回归探测（layer-wise ridge probing）、LEACE风格跨协方差子空间擦除（LEACE-style cross-covariance subspace erasure）以及透明分类器基准测试（与随机特征基线对比），审计三个基础模型（CSBrain、CBraMod、LaBraM）、五个临床任务（MDD、Stress、ISRUC-Sleep、TUSL、Siena）和一个包含6家族63特征的词典。
AI.result: 在945个（模型，任务，特征）单元中，648个（68.6%）是表示因果性的，199个（21.1%）是仅编码的。50个特征跨任务具有通用性。频域特征占主导，但其他五个家族也贡献显著。确认的特征平均恢复基础模型相对于随机基线79.3%的优势，任务梯度从MDD约0.99下降到Stress约0.56。
AI.conclusion: 传统特征目录可以解释大部分EEG基础模型的性能（平均79.3%），但存在非平凡残差，尤其在困难任务上，这为未来概念发现提供了具体目标。
idea_en: A layer-wise ridge probing method for auditing which specific EEG features are learned and causally used by foundation models at different network depths.
A LEACE-style cross-covariance subspace erasure technique to distinguish between features that are merely encoded vs. causally used in EEG foundation model decision-making.
A transparent classifier benchmarking framework with random feature baseline for quantifying how much of foundation model performance advantage can be attributed to a known feature lexicon.
A systematic methodology for evaluating the universality of EEG features across multiple foundation model architectures and clinical tasks, identifying 50 universal candidate features.

A quantitative method for computing the 'task gradient' (from near-ceiling tasks to harder tasks) that pinpoints residual unexplained performance as a target for novel concept discovery in EEG analysis.
idea_ch: 一种层状岭回归探测方法，用于审计EEG基础模型在不同网络深度上学习并因果使用了哪些具体EEG特征。
一种LEACE风格跨协方差子空间擦除技术，用于区分EEG基础模型中仅编码的特征与因果使用的特征。
一种带有随机特征基线的透明分类器基准测试框架，用于量化基础模型性能优势中可归因于已知特征词典的比例。
一种跨多个基础模型架构和临床任务评估EEG特征通用性的系统方法论，识别出50个通用候选特征。
一种量化'任务梯度'（从接近满分的任务到困难任务）的方法，将残余的未解释性能定位为EEG分析中新概念发现的具体目标。

title: Under the Hood of SKILL.md: Semantic Supply-chain Attacks on AI Agent Skill Registry
summary: Autonomous AI agents increasingly extend their capabilities through Agent Skills: modular filesystem packages whose SKILL.md files describe when and how agents should use them. While this design enables scalable, on-demand capability expansion, it also introduces a semantic supply-chain risk in which natural-language metadata and instructions can affect which skills are admitted, surfaced, selected, and loaded. We study SKILL.md - only attacks across three registry-facing stages of the Agent Skill lifecycle, using real ClawHub skills and realistic registry mechanisms. In Discovery, short textual triggers can manipulate embedding-based retrieval and improve adversarial skill visibility, achieving up to 86% pairwise win rate and 80% Top-10 placement. In Selection, description-only framing biases agents toward functionally equivalent adversarial variants, which are selected in 77.6% of paired trials on average. In Governance, semantic evasion strategies cause malicious skills to avoid a blocking verdict in 36.5%-100% of cases. Overall, our results show that SKILL.md is not passive documentation but operational text that shapes which third-party capabilities agents find, trust, and use.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了AI Agent的SKILL.md文件存在语义供应链风险，攻击者可通过操控自然语言元数据在技能发现、选择和治理三个阶段实施攻击，结果表明SKILL.md是影响Agent行为的关键操作文本。
AI.motivation: 随着AI Agent通过Agent Skills（模块化文件系统包）扩展能力，SKILL.md文件中的自然语言描述决定了技能何时以及如何被使用。这种设计引入了语义供应链风险，即恶意攻击者可以通过操控自然语言元数据和指令来影响技能的准入、呈现、选择和加载，但目前缺乏对此类攻击的系统性研究。
AI.method: 作者针对Agent Skill生命周期的三个阶段（发现、选择、治理）设计了三种SKILL.md-only攻击方法：1) 发现阶段：通过短文本触发器操纵基于嵌入的检索；2) 选择阶段：通过描述框架偏差引导Agent选择功能等效的对抗变体；3) 治理阶段：利用语义规避策略使恶意技能绕过审查。使用真实的ClawHub技能和现实注册机制进行实验验证。
AI.result: 1) 发现阶段：短文本触发器可达到86%的成对胜率和80%的Top-10排名；2) 选择阶段：描述框架偏差使Agent在77.6%的配对试验中选择对抗变体；3) 治理阶段：语义规避策略在36.5%-100%的案例中成功绕过封锁判决。
AI.conclusion: SKILL.md不是被动的文档，而是影响第三方能力被发现、信任和使用的操作文本。当前的Agent Skill生态系统存在严重的语义供应链安全风险，需要在元数据层面建立更完善的防御机制。
idea_en: A method for adversarial skill discovery attack using short text triggers to manipulate embedding-based retrieval in AI agent skill registries
A technique for selection bias exploitation through description-only framing that directs AI agents toward functionally equivalent adversarial skill variants
A semantic evasion strategy for bypassing governance blocking verdicts in agent skill lifecycle management
A system for detecting SKILL.md manipulation attacks based on embedding similarity analysis and semantic anomaly detection
A defense mechanism using adversarial training on skill metadata embeddings to resist textual trigger attacks
A secure skill registry architecture with multi-layer semantic verification for agent skill lifecycle
