AI.method: 1) 将LIME特征归因、基于遮挡的词重要性分数和显著性热图作为持久化对象存储在S3兼容存储中，附带结构元数据和自然语言摘要；2) 使用RAG助手对比和综合多种XAI方法的结果，实现多方法解释三角验证；3) 通过自动化检查评估解释的忠实度，包括基础完整性、幻觉声明和方法归因行为。
AI.result: 约束提示将幻觉率降低36%，方法归因引用增加73%。
AI.conclusion: 该架构为受监管金融环境中可信、以人为中心的AI服务提供了有效方案。
idea_en: A method for persistent storage and semantic retrieval of XAI artifacts (LIME, occlusion-based word importance, saliency heatmaps) as structured objects in distributed S3-compatible storage with metadata and natural-language summaries, enabling explanation history search and automatic index reconstruction after failures.

A multi-method explanation triangulation system using Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) that compares and synthesizes results from multiple XAI methods applied to the same prediction, allowing users to assess explanation robustness through natural-language dialogue.

An automated faithfulness evaluation framework for generated explanations that checks grounding completeness, hallucinated claims, and method-attribution behavior, with constrained prompting to reduce hallucination rate by 36% and increase method-attribution citations by 73%.

A human-centered explainable AI architecture for financial sentiment analysis that integrates persistent XAI artifacts, multi-method triangulation via RAG, and automated faithfulness validation in a unified pipeline.
idea_ch: 一种将XAI工件（LIME特征归因、基于遮挡的词重要性分数、显著性热图）作为结构化对象持久化存储在分布式S3兼容存储中的方法，附带元数据和自然语言摘要，支持解释历史语义检索和系统故障后自动索引重建。
一种基于检索增强生成（RAG）的多方法解释三角验证系统，对比和综合同一预测上多种XAI方法的结果，允许用户通过自然语言对话评估解释的鲁棒性。
一种针对生成解释的自动化忠实度评估框架，检查基础完整性、幻觉声明和方法归因行为，通过约束提示将幻觉率降低36%、方法归因引用增加73%。
一种面向金融情感分析的以人为中心的可解释AI架构，将持久化XAI工件、基于RAG的多方法三角验证和自动化忠实度验证集成在统一流水线中。

title: Measuring What Matters Beyond Text: Evaluating Multimodal Summaries by Quality, Alignment, and Diversity
summary: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have facilitated Multimodal Summarization with Multimodal Output (MSMO), wherein systems generate concise textual summaries accompanied by salient visuals from multimodal sources. However, current MSMO evaluation remains fragmented: text quality, image-text alignment, and visual diversity are typically assessed in isolation using unimodal metrics, making it difficult to capture whether the modalities jointly support a faithful and useful summary. To address this gap, we introduce MM-Eval, a unified evaluation framework that integrates assessments of textual quality, cross-modal alignment, and visual diversity. MM-Eval comprises three components: (1) text quality, measured using OpenFActScore for factual consistency and G-Eval for coherence, fluency, and relevance; (2) image-text relevance, evaluated via an MLLM-as-a-judge approach; and (3) image-set diversity, quantified using Truncated CLIP Entropy. We calibrate MM-Eval through a learned aggregation model trained on the mLLM-EVAL news benchmark, aligning component contributions with human preferences. Our analysis reveals a text-dominant hierarchy in this setting, where factual consistency acts as a critical determinant of perceived overall quality, while visual relevance and diversity provide complementary signals. MM-Eval improves over heuristic aggregation baselines and provides an interpretable, reference-weak framework for comparative evaluation of multimodal summaries.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MM-Eval，一个统一的多模态摘要评估框架，整合了文本质量、跨模态对齐和视觉多样性三个维度的评估，通过一个在mLLM-EVAL基准上训练的聚合模型对齐人类偏好，揭示了文本主导的评估层次结构。
AI.motivation: 现有MSMO评估方法碎片化，文本质量、图像-文本对齐和视觉多样性通常使用单模态指标孤立评估，难以捕捉模态间是否共同支持忠实且有用的摘要。
AI.method: MM-Eval包含三个组件：(1)文本质量：用OpenFActScore评估事实一致性，G-Eval评估连贯性、流畅性和相关性；(2)图像-文本相关性：用MLLM-as-a-judge方法；(3)图像集多样性：用Truncated CLIP Entropy量化。通过一个在mLLM-EVAL新闻基准上训练的聚合模型校准各组件权重。
AI.result: 分析揭示了文本主导的层次结构，事实一致性是感知整体质量的关键决定因素，视觉相关性和多样性提供互补信号。MM-Eval优于启发式聚合基线，提供了一个可解释的、弱参考的多模态摘要评估框架。
AI.conclusion: MM-Eval统一了多模态摘要评估的三个维度，通过可学习的聚合模型对齐人类偏好，为MSMO领域提供了一个更全面、可解释的评估方案。
idea_en: A unified evaluation framework (MM-Eval) that integrates textual quality, cross-modal alignment, and visual diversity for multimodal summarization with multimodal output (MSMO) using a learned aggregation model.
An MLLM-as-a-judge approach for evaluating image-text relevance in multimodal summaries, leveraging multimodal large language models as the evaluation oracle.
Truncated CLIP Entropy as a novel metric for quantifying image-set diversity in multimodal summarization outputs.
A learned aggregation model trained on human preference data to calibrate the contributions of text quality, image-text relevance, and visual diversity components in a unified evaluation score.
A reference-weak evaluation framework that does not require ground-truth summaries, enabling comparative assessment of multimodal summaries in open-ended generation scenarios.
idea_ch: 一种统一评估框架MM-Eval，通过可学习聚合模型整合文本质量、跨模态对齐和视觉多样性三个维度，用于多模态输出的多模态摘要评估。
基于MLLM-as-a-judge的图像-文本相关性评估方法，利用多模态大语言模型作为评估判官。
截断CLIP熵(Truncated CLIP Entropy)指标，用于量化多模态摘要输出中图像集合的多样性。
在人类偏好数据上训练的可学习聚合模型，用于校准文本质量、图像-文本相关性和视觉多样性三个评估组件的贡献权重。
一种弱参考评估框架，无需真实摘要作为参照，支持开放生成场景下多模态摘要的比较评估。

title: Toward Stable Value Alignment: Introducing Independent Modules for Consistent Value Guidance
summary: Aligning large language models (LLMs) with human values typically relies on post-training or inference-time steering that directly manipulates the backbone's parameters or representation space. However, a critical gap exists: the model's residual stream is highly dynamic, in which values exist as fragile, low-dimensional properties, inherently incompatible with the stability required for consistent value expression. In this paper, we propose the Stable Value Guidance Transformer (SVGT), which addresses this gap through an independent value module incorporating two key designs: (1) independent value modeling, maintaining normative representations in a dedicated value space isolated from the backbone, and (2) explicit behavioral guidance, transducing these stable signals into learnable latent Bridge Tokens. These tokens serve as dynamic value anchors to explicitly steer the generative trajectory, ensuring robust adherence across diverse contexts without disrupting the backbone's internal representations. Experiments across multiple backbones and safety benchmarks show that SVGT generally reduces harmful scores by over 70% while maintaining generation fluency, demonstrating the efficacy of architecturally grounded value modeling. Our code is available at https://github.com/Clervils/SVGT.git.

AI.tldr: SVGT通过独立的价值模块和桥接令牌机制，在保持生成流畅性的同时，将LLM的有害内容生成率降低超过70%。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM对齐方法在残差流中直接操纵参数或表示空间，但残差流高度动态，价值观作为脆弱、低维属性存在，难以实现稳定的价值表达。
AI.method: 提出SVGT框架，包含两个核心设计：(1)独立价值建模——在独立于骨干网络的价值空间中维护规范性表示；(2)显式行为引导——将稳定信号转导为可学习的潜在桥接令牌(Bridge Tokens)，作为动态价值锚点显式引导生成轨迹。
AI.result: 在多个骨干网络和安全基准上，SVGT将有害分数降低超过70%，同时保持生成流畅性。
AI.conclusion: 架构层面的价值建模方法有效解决了LLM价值对齐中的稳定性问题，实现了鲁棒的价值表达。
idea_en: Independent value module architecture for LLMs that maintains normative representations in a dedicated value space isolated from the backbone network.
Learnable latent Bridge Tokens mechanism that transduces stable value signals into dynamic value anchors for steering generative trajectories.
Architecturally grounded value modeling that separates value representation from the dynamic residual stream to ensure stable value expression.
Method for explicitly guiding LLM behavior using Bridge Tokens without disrupting the backbone's internal representations.
System for reducing harmful content generation by over 70% through independent value space and Bridge Token-based steering.
idea_ch: 一种独立于骨干网络的价值模块架构，在专用价值空间中维护规范性表示，实现LLM的稳定价值对齐。
可学习的潜在桥接令牌(Bridge Tokens)机制，将稳定价值信号转导为动态价值锚点，显式引导生成轨迹。
基于架构的价值建模方法，将价值表示与动态残差流分离，确保稳定的价值表达。
利用桥接令牌显式引导LLM行为而不干扰骨干网络内部表示的方法。
通过独立价值空间和桥接令牌引导将有害内容生成率降低70%以上的系统。

title: SafeSteer: A Decoding-level Defense Mechanism for Multimodal Large Language Models
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) are gaining increasing attention. Due to the heterogeneity of their input features, they face significant challenges in terms of jailbreak defenses. Current defense methods rely on costly fine-tuning or inefficient post-hoc interventions, limiting their ability to address novel attacks and involving performance trade-offs. To address the above issues, we explore the inherent safety capabilities within MLLMs and quantify their intrinsic ability to discern harmfulness at decoding stage. We observe that 1) MLLMs can distinguish the harmful and harmless inputs during decoding process, 2) Image-based attacks are more stealthy. Based on these insights, we introduce SafeSteer, a decoding-level defense mechanism for MLLMs. Specifically, it includes a Decoding-Probe, a lightweight probe for detecting and correcting harmful output during decoding, which iteratively steers the decoding process toward safety. Furthermore, a modal semantic alignment vector is integrated to transfer the strong textual safety alignment to the vision modality. Experiments on multiple MLLMs demonstrate that SafeSterr can improve MLLMs' safety by up to 33.40\% without fine-tuning. Notably, it can maintain the effectiveness of MLLMs, ensuring a balance between their helpfulness and harmlessness.

AI.tldr: SafeSteer是一种无需微调的MLLM解码级防御机制，通过轻量级Decoding-Probe检测和纠正有害输出，并利用模态语义对齐向量将文本安全对齐迁移至视觉模态，在不影响性能的前提下显著提升模型安全性。
AI.motivation: 多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）因输入特征异质性面临严峻的越狱攻击防御挑战。现有防御方法依赖昂贵的微调或低效的后处理干预，难以应对新型攻击且存在性能权衡问题。
AI.method: 1) 提出Decoding-Probe轻量级探针，在解码阶段实时检测并纠正有害输出，迭代引导解码朝向安全方向；2) 引入模态语义对齐向量，将文本模态的强安全对齐能力迁移至视觉模态。
AI.result: 在多个MLLM上实验表明，SafeSteer无需微调即可将安全性提升高达33.40%，同时保持模型的有效性，实现有用性与无害性的平衡。
AI.conclusion: SafeSteer证明了MLLM在解码阶段具备内在有害性辨别能力，并利用这一特性实现了高效、轻量的防御方案，为多模态安全对齐提供了新思路。
idea_en: A decoding-stage harmfulness detection method for multimodal large language models that uses a lightweight probe to iteratively steer the decoding process away from harmful outputs without requiring model fine-tuning.
A cross-modal semantic alignment mechanism that transfers textual safety alignment capabilities to the vision modality, enabling robust defense against image-based jailbreak attacks.
A real-time harmfulness discernment technique that quantifies an MLLM's intrinsic ability to distinguish harmful vs. harmless inputs during the decoding process.
idea_ch: 一种面向多模态大语言模型的解码阶段有害性检测方法，利用轻量级探针在解码过程中迭代引导生成结果远离有害输出，无需模型微调。
一种跨模态语义对齐机制，将文本模态的安全对齐能力迁移至视觉模态，有效防御基于图像的越狱攻击。
一种实时有害性辨别技术，在解码阶段量化MLLM内在的有害/无害输入区分能力，实现动态安全干预。

title: Allegory of the Cave: Measurement-Grounded Vision-Language Learning
summary: Vision-language models typically reason over post-ISP RGB images, although RGB rendering can clip, suppress, or quantize sensor evidence before inference. We study whether grounding improves when the visual interface is moved closer to the underlying camera measurement. We formulate measurement-grounded vision-language learning and instantiate it as PRISM-VL, which combines RAW-derived Meas.-XYZ inputs, camera-conditioned grounding, and Exposure-Bracketed Supervision Aggregation for transferring supervision from RGB proxies to measurement-domain observations. Using a quality-controlled 150K instruction-tuning set and a held-out benchmark targeting low-light, HDR, visibility-sensitive, and hallucination-sensitive cases, PRISM-VL-8B reaches 0.6120 BLEU, 0.4571 ROUGE-L, and 82.66\% LLM-Judge accuracy, improving over the RGB Qwen3-VL-8B baseline by +0.1074 BLEU, +0.1071 ROUGE-L, and +4.46 percentage points. These results suggest that part of VLM grounding error arises from information lost during RGB rendering, and that preserving measurement-domain evidence can improve multimodal reasoning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PRISM-VL，通过使用RAW域测量数据替代传统ISP后的RGB图像作为视觉输入，将视觉-语言模型的接口向相机原始测量靠近，显著提升多模态推理能力，实验表明RGB渲染过程丢失的信息是VLM接地错误的重要来源。
AI.motivation: 传统视觉-语言模型基于经过ISP处理的RGB图像进行推理，但RGB渲染过程会裁剪、抑制或量化传感器证据，导致信息丢失进而影响模型接地准确性。本文探究将视觉接口向相机原始测量值移动是否能改善接地性能。
AI.method: 提出PRISM-VL框架：(1) 使用RAW域衍生的Meas.-XYZ输入替代传统RGB；(2) 采用相机条件接地（camera-conditioned grounding）；(3) 引入曝光包围监督聚合（Exposure-Bracketed Supervision Aggregation）将RGB代理的监督信号迁移到测量域。构建了15万条质量控制的指令微调集和针对低光、HDR、可见性敏感和幻觉敏感场景的测试基准。
AI.result: PRISM-VL-8B在BLEU达到0.6120（+0.1074），ROUGE-L达到0.4571（+0.1071），LLM-Judge准确率达到82.66%（+4.46个百分点），全面超越RGB基线的Qwen3-VL-8B。
AI.conclusion: 部分VLM接地误差源于RGB渲染过程中的信息丢失，保留测量域证据可以改善多模态推理能力。
idea_en: A vision-language reasoning method using RAW-domain Meas.-XYZ inputs instead of post-ISP RGB images to preserve sensor evidence.
Camera-conditioned grounding technique that adapts visual-language alignment based on specific camera sensor characteristics for improved multimodal reasoning.
Exposure-Bracketed Supervision Aggregation (EBSA) method that transfers supervision signals from RGB proxy models to measurement-domain observations using multi-exposure RAW data.
A measurement-grounded vision-language learning framework that moves the visual interface closer to underlying camera measurements before ISP processing.
A quality-controlled instruction-tuning dataset with 150K samples specifically designed for RAW-domain vision-language model training.
A held-out benchmark evaluation protocol targeting low-light, HDR, visibility-sensitive, and hallucination-sensitive cases for measurement-grounded VLMs.
idea_ch: 一种使用RAW域Meas.-XYZ输入替代传统ISP后RGB图像的视觉-语言推理方法，保留传感器原始证据避免信息丢失
基于相机条件接地的技术，根据特定相机传感器特性自适应调整视觉-语言对齐，提升多模态推理准确性
曝光包围监督聚合方法（EBSA），利用多曝光RAW数据将RGB代理模型的监督信号迁移到测量域观测
一种测量接地视觉-语言学习框架，在ISP处理之前将视觉接口移动到更接近相机原始测量的位置
专门面向RAW域视觉-语言模型训练的质量控制指令微调数据集（15万样本）
针对低光、高动态范围、可见性敏感和幻觉敏感场景的测量接地VLM评估基准协议

title: OptArgus: A Multi-Agent System to Detect Hallucinations in LLM-based Optimization Modeling
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to translate natural-language optimization problems into mathematical formulations and solver code, but matching the reference objective value is not a reliable test of correctness: an artifact may agree numerically while still changing the underlying optimization semantics. We formulate this issue as \emph{optimization-modeling hallucination detection}, namely structural consistency auditing over the problem description, symbolic model, and solver implementation. We develop, to our knowledge, the first fine-grained hallucination taxonomy specifically for optimization modeling, spanning objective, variable, constraint, and implementation failures. We use this taxonomy to design OptArgus, a multi-agent detector with conductor routing, specialist auditors, and evidence consolidation. To evaluate this setting, we introduce a three-part benchmark suite with $484$ clean artifacts, $1266$ controlled injected artifacts, and $6292$ natural LLM-generated artifacts. Against a matched single-agent baseline, OptArgus produces fewer false alarms on clean artifacts, more accurate top-ranked localization on controlled single-error cases, and stronger detection on natural model outputs. Together, these contributions turn optimization-modeling hallucination detection into a concrete empirical problem and suggest that modular, taxonomy-grounded auditing is a practical route to more reliable optimization modeling.

AI.tldr: 本文提出优化建模幻觉检测问题，构建了细粒度幻觉分类体系，并设计多智能体检测器OptArgus，用于检测从自然语言优化问题到数学模型和求解器代码转换中的结构性不一致问题。
AI.motivation: LLM在将自然语言优化问题转换为数学公式和求解代码时，即使目标函数数值匹配，也可能存在语义层面的错误（即优化建模幻觉），现有方法缺乏结构性一致性审计。
AI.method: 提出优化建模幻觉分类体系（目标、变量、约束、实现四类失败）；设计OptArgus多智能体检测器，包含路由调度、专业审计器和证据整合模块；构建三部分基准测试集（484个干净样本、1266个注入错误样本、6292个LLM生成样本）。
AI.result: 相比单智能体基线，OptArgus在干净样本上误报更少，在单错误注入样本上定位更准，在自然LLM模型输出上检测更强。
AI.conclusion: 模块化、基于分类体系的审计是实现更可靠优化建模的实用路径，将优化建模幻觉检测转化为具体的实证问题。
idea_en: Multi-agent hallucination detection system for optimization modeling with specialized auditor agents for objectives, variables, constraints, and implementation.
Fine-grained hallucination taxonomy specifically designed for optimization modeling (objective, variable, constraint, implementation failures).
Evidence consolidation mechanism that integrates findings from multiple specialist auditors to provide comprehensive structural consistency auditing.
Conductor routing architecture that dynamically dispatches auditing tasks to specialist agents based on artifact type.
Three-part benchmark suite with controlled injected artifacts for evaluating optimization-modeling hallucination detection systems.
idea_ch: 一种面向优化建模的多智能体幻觉检测系统，包含专门针对目标函数、变量、约束条件和代码实现的专业审计智能体
一种专用于优化建模的细粒度幻觉分类体系，将幻觉分为目标函数错误、变量错误、约束条件和实现错误四类
一种证据整合机制，聚合多个专业审计智能体的发现结果，提供全面的结构一致性审计报告
一种指挥路由架构，根据工件类型动态分配审计任务给对应的专业智能体
一种三部分基准测试集，包含受控注入的合成错误，用于评估优化建模幻觉检测系统的性能

title: When Reasoning Traces Become Performative: Step-Level Evidence that Chain-of-Thought Is an Imperfect Oversight Channel
summary: Chain-of-thought (CoT) traces are increasingly used both to improve language model capability and to audit model behavior, implicitly assuming that the visible trace remains synchronized with the computation that determines the answer. We test this assumption with a step-level Detect-Classify-Compare framework built around an answer-commitment proxy that is cross-validated with Patchscopes, tuned-lens probes, and causal direction ablation. Across nine models and seven reasoning benchmarks, latent commitment and explicit answer arrival align on only 61.9% of steps on average. The dominant mismatch pattern is confabulated continuation: 58.0% of detected mismatch events occur after the answer-commitment proxy has already stabilized while the trace continues producing deliberative-looking text, and a vacuousness analysis shows that the committed answer does not change during these steps. In architecture-matched Qwen2.5/DeepSeek-R1-Distill comparisons, the reasoning pipeline changes failure composition more than aggregate alignment, most clearly at 32B where confabulated steps decrease as contradictory states increase. Lower step-level alignment is also associated with larger CoT utility, suggesting that the settings that benefit most from CoT are often the least temporally faithful. Paired truncation and a complementary donor-corruption test further indicate that much post-commitment text is not load-bearing for the final answer. These findings suggest that CoT can remain useful while still being an unreliable report of when the answer was formed.

AI.tldr: 本文通过Detect-Classify-Compare框架验证了Chain-of-Thought推理过程中，模型隐式答案承诺与显式推理轨迹之间存在显著的时间错位，平均仅有61.9%的步骤保持同步，且大部分不一致表现为“虚构延续”——模型在答案已确定后继续生成看似深思熟虑的推理文本。
AI.motivation: 现有研究假设CoT推理轨迹与模型内部计算过程是同步的，这一假设被用于模型能力提升和行为审计，但缺乏严格验证。本文旨在检验这一关键假设的可靠性。
AI.method: 提出Detect-Classify-Compare三步框架：1) 使用答案承诺代理（交叉验证Patchscopes、调谐透镜探针、因果方向消融）检测隐式答案形成时刻；2) 分类承诺时刻与显式答案到达时刻之间的对齐模式；3) 通过截断实验和捐赠者-污染测试分析后承诺文本的功能重要性。
AI.result: 九种模型和七个推理基准上，隐式承诺与显式答案对齐率仅61.9%。58.0%的不一致事件为“虚构延续”——答案已承诺但推理轨迹继续生成。在Qwen2.5/DeepSeek-R1-Distill对比中，32B模型虚构步骤减少但矛盾状态增多。低步骤对齐与更大的CoT效用相关。
AI.conclusion: CoT推理轨迹虽然是实用的，但并非答案形成时刻的可靠时间报告。模型在答案已确定后仍会继续生成推理文本，这挑战了CoT作为忠实认知过程记录的基本假设。
idea_en: A method for detecting temporal misalignment between latent answer commitment and explicit chain-of-thought reasoning traces using a Detect-Classify-Compare framework with answer-commitment proxies cross-validated by Patchscopes, tuned-lens probes, and causal direction ablation.

A technique for identifying and classifying confabulated continuation patterns in language model reasoning, where the model continues generating deliberative text after the answer has already been internally committed.
A paired truncation methodology to determine whether post-commitment reasoning text is load-bearing for the final answer, enabling evaluation of reasoning efficiency.
A donor-corruption test that measures the functional importance of post-commitment text by corrupting it and observing answer changes.
A vacuousness analysis method to verify that committed answers do not change during confabulated continuation steps in chain-of-thought reasoning.
An architecture-aware comparison framework (applicable to Qwen2.5/DeepSeek-R1-Distill) that analyzes how reasoning pipeline changes affect failure composition and step-level alignment.
idea_ch: 一种基于Detect-Classify-Compare框架的检测方法，利用Patchscopes、调谐透镜探针和因果方向消融交叉验证的答案承诺代理，检测隐式答案承诺与显式CoT推理轨迹之间的时间错位
一种识别和分类语言模型推理中“虚构延续”模式的技术，即模型在内部已确定答案后仍继续生成看似深思熟虑的推理文本
一种配对截断方法，用于确定后承诺推理文本是否对最终答案具有承重作用，从而评估推理效率
一种捐赠者-污染测试方法，通过污染后承诺文本并观察答案变化来衡量其功能重要性
一种空洞性分析方法，用于验证在虚构延续步骤中已承诺的答案是否实际发生改变
一种架构感知的比较框架（适用于Qwen2.5/DeepSeek-R1-Distill），分析推理管线变化如何影响失败构成和步骤级对齐

title: Towards Visually Grounded Multimodal Summarization via Cross-Modal Transformer and Gated Attention
summary: Multimodal summarization requires models to jointly understand textual and visual inputs to generate concise, semantically coherent summaries. Existing methods often inject shallow visual features into deep language models, leading to representational mismatches and weak cross-modal grounding. We propose a unified framework that jointly performs text summarization and representative image selection. Our system, SPeCTrA-Sum (Sampler Perceiver with Cross-modal Transformer and gated Attention for Summarization), introduces two key innovations. First, a Deep Visual Processor (DVP) aligns the visual encoder with the language model at corresponding depths, enabling hierarchical, layer-wise fusion that preserves semantic consistency. Second, a lightweight Visual Relevance Predictor (VRP) selects salient and diverse images by distilling soft labels from a Determinantal Point Processes (DPP) teacher. SPeCTrA-Sum is trained using a multi-objective loss that combines autoregressive summarization, cross-modal alignment, and DPP-based distillation. Experiments show that our system produces more accurate, visually grounded summaries and selects more representative images, demonstrating the benefits of depth-aware fusion and principled image selection for multimodal summarization.

AI.tldr: 提出SPeCTrA-Sum统一框架，通过深度视觉处理器（DVP）实现层次化跨模态融合，并利用视觉相关性预测器（VRP）基于DPP蒸馏选择代表性图像，提升多模态摘要的语义一致性和视觉接地能力。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态摘要方法将浅层视觉特征注入深度语言模型，导致表征不匹配和跨模态接地薄弱。
AI.method: 提出SPeCTrA-Sum框架，包含：1) 深度视觉处理器(DVP)在对应深度层对齐视觉编码器与语言模型；2) 轻量级视觉相关性预测器(VRP)通过DPP教师蒸馏选择显著且多样的图像；3) 多目标损失联合训练自回归摘要、跨模态对齐和DPP蒸馏。
AI.result: 生成更准确、视觉接地更好的摘要，选择更具代表性的图像。
AI.conclusion: 深度感知融合和基于DPP的图像选择有效提升多模态摘要性能。
idea_en: A deep visual processor (DVP) that aligns visual encoder with language model at corresponding depths, enabling hierarchical layer-wise cross-modal fusion while preserving semantic consistency.
A lightweight visual relevance predictor (VRP) that selects salient and diverse images by distilling soft labels from a Determinantal Point Processes (DPP) teacher model.
A multi-objective training framework combining autoregressive summarization loss, cross-modal alignment loss, and DPP-based distillation loss for multimodal summarization.
Depth-aware cross-modal fusion mechanism that maps visual features to match the representational granularity of each transformer layer in the language model.
idea_ch: 深度视觉处理器（DVP）：在语言模型的对应深度层对齐视觉编码器，实现层次化逐层跨模态融合，保持语义一致性
轻量级视觉相关性预测器（VRP）：通过从行列式点过程（DPP）教师模型蒸馏软标签，选择显著且多样化的代表性图像
多目标联合训练框架：结合自回归摘要损失、跨模态对齐损失和DPP蒸馏损失，统一优化多模态摘要生成和图像选择
深度感知的跨模态融合机制：将视觉特征映射到与语言模型各Transformer层匹配的表征粒度，解决浅层特征注入导致的表征不匹配问题

title: Beyond Inefficiency: Systemic Costs of Incivility in Multi-Agent Monte Carlo Simulations
summary: Unconstructive debate and uncivil communication carry well-documented costs for productivity and cohesion, yet isolating their effect on operational efficiency has proven difficult. Human subject research in this domain is constrained by ethical oversight, limited reproducibility, and the inherent unpredictability of naturalistic settings. We address this gap by leveraging Large Language Model (LLM) based Multi-Agent Systems as a controlled sociological sandbox, enabling systematic manipulation of communicative behavior at scale. Using a Monte Carlo simulation framework, we generate thousands of structured 1-on-1 adversarial debates across varying toxicity conditions, measuring convergence time, defined as the number of rounds required to reach a conclusion, as a proxy for interactional efficiency. Building on a prior study, we replicate and extend its findings across two additional LLM agents of varying parameter size, allowing us to assess whether the effects of toxic behavior on debate dynamics generalize across model scale. The convergence latency of 25% reported in the previous study was confirmed. It was found that this latency is significantly bigger for models with fewer parameters. We further identify a significant first-mover advantage, whereby the agent initiating the discussion wins significantly above chance regardless of toxicity condition.

AI.tldr: 利用LLM多智能体系统作为可控社会沙盒，通过蒙特卡洛模拟生成数千场不同毒性条件的对抗辩论，验证了毒性行为导致25%的收敛延迟，发现小参数模型延迟更显著，并揭示了显著的先发优势效应。
AI.motivation: 现有研究难以隔离不文明沟通对运营效率的因果影响，人类受试研究受伦理限制、可重复性差和自然场景不可控的制约，亟需一种可控、可扩展的研究方法。
AI.method: 基于LLM的多智能体系统作为可控社会学沙盒，采用蒙特卡洛模拟框架生成数千场结构化1对1对抗辩论，在不同毒性条件下测量收敛时间作为效率指标，并在多个参数规模的LLM上复现和扩展先前研究。
AI.result: 先前的25%收敛延迟被确认，且小参数模型延迟更显著；发现了显著的第一发起者优势，即发起辩论的代理人在所有毒性条件下胜率均显著高于随机水平。
AI.conclusion: LLM多智能体系统可有效模拟人类辩论中的毒性效应，毒性行为对辩论效率有稳健的负面影响，且模型规模影响效应强度；先发优势是独立于毒性的普遍现象。
idea_en: A Monte Carlo simulation framework for generating structured adversarial debates using LLM-based multi-agent systems to systematically manipulate communicative behavior and measure interactional efficiency.
A method for measuring convergence latency in multi-agent debates under varying toxicity conditions as a quantitative proxy for operational efficiency.
An LLM-based controlled sociological sandbox system that enables reproducible and ethical study of uncivil communication effects on debate dynamics.
A technique for identifying first-mover advantage in multi-agent adversarial debates by analyzing win rates relative to debate initiation order across toxicity conditions.
A cross-scale comparison methodology for assessing how LLM parameter size modulates the impact of toxic behavior on debate convergence time.
idea_ch: 基于LLM多智能体系统的蒙特卡洛模拟框架，用于生成结构化对抗辩论并通过系统操控沟通行为来测量交互效率
在不同毒性条件下测量多智能体辩论收敛延迟的方法，作为运营效率的量化代理指标
一种可控社会学沙盒系统，利用LLM实现可复现、符合伦理的不文明沟通效应研究
通过分析不同毒性条件下辩手发起顺序与胜率的关系，识别多智能体对抗辩论中的先发优势的技术
跨模型参数规模的比较方法，用于评估LLM规模如何调节毒性行为对辩论收敛时间的影响

title: Why Users Go There: World Knowledge-Augmented Generative Next POI Recommendation
summary: Generative point-of-interest (POI) recommendation models based on large language models (LLMs) have shown promising results by formulating next POI prediction as a sequence generation task. However, the knowledge encoded in these models remains fixed after training, making them unable to perceive evolving real-world conditions that shape user mobility decisions, such as local events and cultural trends. To bridge this gap, we propose AWARE (Agent-based World knowledge Augmented REcommendation), which employs an LLM agent to generate location- and time-aware contextual narratives that capture regional cultural characteristics, seasonal trends, and ongoing events relevant to each user. Rather than introducing generic or noisy information, AWARE further anchors these narratives in each user's behavioral context, grounding external world knowledge in personalized spatial-temporal patterns. Extensive experiments on three real-world datasets demonstrate that AWARE consistently outperforms competitive baselines, achieving up to 12.4% relative improvement.

AI.tldr: 提出AWARE框架，利用LLM智能体生成基于位置和时间的上下文叙事，将外部世界知识融入个性化时空模式，以提升生成式POI推荐性能。
AI.motivation: 现有生成式POI推荐模型的知识在训练后固定不变，无法感知不断变化的现实世界条件（如本地事件、文化趋势），导致推荐效果受限。
AI.method: 采用LLM智能体生成位置感知和时间感知的上下文叙事，捕获区域文化特征、季节趋势和当前事件；并将这些叙事锚定在用户行为上下文中，实现外部世界知识与个性化时空模式的结合。
AI.result: 在三个真实数据集上，AWARE一致优于竞争基线，最高相对提升12.4%。
AI.conclusion: 通过LLM智能体引入动态外部世界知识并个性化融入用户行为模式，能显著提升生成式POI推荐的效果。
idea_en: An LLM agent-based method for generating location-aware and time-aware contextual narratives that capture regional cultural characteristics, seasonal trends, and ongoing events for POI recommendation.
A technique for anchoring external world knowledge narratives into a user's behavioral context, grounding general world knowledge in personalized spatial-temporal patterns.
A framework integrating dynamically updated world knowledge (events, cultural trends, seasons) into generative POI recommendation without retraining the underlying LLM model.
idea_ch: 基于LLM智能体生成位置感知和时间感知的上下文叙事的方法，用于捕获区域文化特征、季节趋势和当前事件以增强POI推荐。
将外部世界知识叙事锚定在用户行为上下文中的技术，将通用世界知识融入个性化时空模式。
一种无需重新训练底层LLM模型即可将动态更新的世界知识（事件、文化趋势、季节）集成到生成式POI推荐中的框架。

title: Beyond World-Frame Action Heads: Motion-Centric Action Frames for Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have advanced rapidly with stronger backbones, broader pre-training, and larger demonstration datasets, yet their action heads remain largely homogeneous: most directly predict action commands in a fixed world coordinate frame. We propose \textbf{MCF-Proto}, a lightweight action head that equips VLA policies with a Motion-Centric Action Frame (MCF) and a prototype-based action parameterization. At each step, the policy predicts a rotation $R_t \in SO(3)$, composes actions in the transformed local frame from a set of prototypes, and maps them back to the world frame for end-to-end training, using only standard demonstrations without auxiliary supervision. This simple design induces stable emergent structure. Without explicit directional labels, the learned local frames develop a stable geometric structure whose axes are strongly compatible with demonstrated end-effector motion. Meanwhile, actions in the learned representation become substantially more compact, with variation captured by fewer dominant directions and more regularly organized by shared prototypes. These structural properties translate into improved robustness, especially under geometric perturbations. Our results suggest that adding lightweight geometric and compositional structure to the action head can materially improve how VLA policies organize and generalize robotic manipulation behavior. An anonymized code repository is provided in the supplementary material.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MCF-Proto，一种轻量级动作头，通过运动中心动作帧(MCF)和基于原型的动作参数化，赋予VLA策略几何与组合结构，无需辅助监督即可实现动作表示的紧凑化与鲁棒性提升。
AI.motivation: 现有VLA模型的动作头结构单一，大多直接在固定世界坐标系中预测动作命令，缺乏对动作几何结构和组合规律的利用，导致在几何扰动下鲁棒性不足。
AI.method: MCF-Proto包含两部分：1) 运动中心动作帧(MCF)：策略每步预测一个旋转R_t∈SO(3)，在变换后的局部坐标系中组合动作；2) 基于原型的动作参数化：从一组可学习原型中组合动作，再映射回世界坐标系，实现端到端训练，仅使用标准演示数据。
AI.result: 学到的局部帧在无方向标签下发展出稳定的几何结构，其轴与演示的末端执行器运动高度兼容；动作表示更紧凑，变化由更少的主方向捕获并由共享原型有规律组织；在几何扰动下展现出更强的鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 为VLA策略的动作头添加轻量级几何与组合结构，能够实质性改善机器人操作行为的组织方式与泛化能力。
idea_en: A motion-centric action frame (MCF) method that predicts a rotation R_t in SO(3) at each step to transform action representation into a local coordinate frame aligned with end-effector motion, enabling more compact and robust action prediction.

A prototype-based action parameterization system that composes actions from a set of learnable prototypes within the transformed local frame, allowing end-to-end training using only standard demonstrations without auxiliary supervision.

A method for learning stable geometric structures in action representation without explicit directional labels, where the axes of learned local frames automatically align with demonstrated end-effector motion.
A lightweight action head architecture that integrates geometric transformation (rotation prediction) with compositional prototype selection for Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies.
A technique for improving VLA policy robustness to geometric perturbations by enforcing motion-centric action frame constraints and prototype-based action decomposition.
idea_ch: 一种运动中心动作帧方法，每步预测SO(3)中的旋转R_t，将动作表示变换到与末端执行器运动对齐的局部坐标系，实现更紧凑鲁棒的动作预测。
一种基于原型的动作参数化系统，在变换后的局部帧中从一组可学习原型组合动作，仅使用标准演示数据即可端到端训练，无需辅助监督。
一种无需显式方向标签即可学习动作表示稳定几何结构的方法，学到的局部帧轴自动与演示的末端执行器运动对齐。
一种轻量级动作头架构，将几何变换（旋转预测）与组合原型选择集成到视觉-语言-动作(VLA)策略中。
一种通过强制运动中心动作帧约束和基于原型的动作分解来提升VLA策略对几何扰动鲁棒性的技术。

title: Automated Reformulation of Robust Optimization via Memory-Augmented Large Language Models
summary: Robust optimization (RO) provides a principled framework for decision-making under uncertainty, but its practical use is often limited by the need to manually reformulate uncertain optimization models into tractable deterministic counterparts. Recent large language models (LLMs) have been shown promising for automating optimization formulation, yet RO reformulation remains challenging because it requires precise multi-step reasoning and mathematically consistent transformations. To facilitate systematic evaluation of LLM-based reformulation, for which no dedicated benchmark currently exists, we develop AutoRO-Bench, a benchmark featuring an automated data generation pipeline for the core RO reformulation task and a curated dataset for the RO application task. To address the reformulation challenge, we propose Automated Reformulation with Experience Memory (AutoREM), a tuning-free memory-augmented framework that autonomously builds a structured textual experience memory by reflecting on past failed trajectories through a tailored offline adaptation procedure. AutoREM requires neither domain-specific expert knowledge nor parameter updates, and the resulting memory readily transfers across different base LLMs. Experimental results show that AutoREM consistently improves the accuracy and efficiency of RO reformulation across in-distribution datasets, out-of-distribution datasets, and diverse base LLMs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了AutoRO-Bench基准测试和AutoREM框架，用于解决鲁棒优化中的自动化重构问题，通过经验记忆增强大语言模型的重构能力，无需调参或专家知识。
AI.motivation: 鲁棒优化在实际应用中需要手动将不确定优化模型转化为可求解的确定性形式，这一过程繁琐且易错。现有LLM在自动化优化建模方面有潜力，但RO重构需要精确的多步推理和数学一致性变换，目前缺乏专门基准测试和有效的解决方案。
AI.method: 提出AutoRO-Bench基准测试（含自动数据生成管道和人工标注数据集）和AutoREM框架（无需调参的记忆增强框架，通过离线自适应过程反思失败轨迹，自主构建结构化文本经验记忆，可直接迁移至不同基础LLM）。
AI.result: 实验表明AutoREM在分布内数据集、分布外数据集及不同基础LLM上，一致性地提升了RO重构的准确性和效率。
AI.conclusion: AutoREM通过经验记忆增强有效解决了LLM在RO自动化重构中的挑战，且无需参数更新或专家知识，具有良好的跨模型迁移能力。
idea_en: A tuning-free memory-augmented framework (AutoREM) for automated robust optimization reformulation that builds structured textual experience memory by reflecting on past failure trajectories
An automated data generation pipeline for robust optimization reformulation benchmark (AutoRO-Bench) enabling systematic evaluation of LLM reformulation capabilities
A cross-model transferable experience memory mechanism that improves RO reformulation accuracy across different base LLMs without parameter updates
An offline adaptation procedure that autonomously constructs structured experience memory from failed reformulation trajectories
idea_ch: 一种免调参的记忆增强框架(AutoREM)，通过反思历史失败轨迹自动构建结构化文本经验记忆，用于自动化鲁棒优化重构
一种用于鲁棒优化重构的自动化基准数据生成管道(AutoRO-Bench)，支持对LLM重构能力进行系统评估
一种跨模型可迁移的经验记忆机制，无需参数更新即可在不同基础LLM上提升RO重构准确性
一种离线自适应流程，能够从失败的重构轨迹中自主构建结构化经验记忆

title: MedMemoryBench: Benchmarking Agent Memory in Personalized Healthcare
summary: The large-scale deployment of personalized healthcare agents demands memory mechanisms that are exceptionally precise, safe, and capable of long-term clinical tracking. However, existing benchmarks primarily focus on daily open-domain conversations, failing to capture the high-stakes complexity of real-world medical applications. Motivated by the stringent production requirements of an industry-leading health management agent serving tens of millions of active users, we introduce MedMemoryBench. We develop a human-agent collaborative pipeline to synthesize highly realistic, long-horizon medical trajectories based on clinically grounded, synthetic patient archetypes. This process yields a massive, expertly validated dataset comprising approximately 2,000 sessions and 16,000 interaction turns. Crucially, MedMemoryBench departs from traditional static evaluations by pioneering an "evaluate-while-constructing" streaming assessment protocol, which precisely mirrors dynamic memory accumulation in production environments. Furthermore, we formalize and systematically investigate the critical phenomenon of memory saturation, where sustained information influx actively degrades retrieval and reasoning robustness. Comprehensive benchmarking reveals severe bottlenecks in mainstream architectures, particularly concerning complex medical reasoning and noise resilience. By exposing these fundamental flaws, MedMemoryBench establishes a vital foundation for developing robust, production-ready medical agents.

AI.tldr: 提出了MedMemoryBench，一个面向医疗健康代理的长期记忆评估基准，包含约2000个会话、16000轮交互的合成医疗轨迹数据集，并首创"边构建边评估"的流式评估协议，揭示了记忆饱和现象对主流架构的严重性能瓶颈。
AI.motivation: 现有基准主要聚焦日常开放域对话，无法捕捉真实医疗应用的高风险复杂性。面向千万级用户的健康管理代理在生产环境中对记忆机制的精确性、安全性和长期临床追踪能力有极高要求，但缺乏合适的评估基准。
AI.method: 1) 构建人机协作管道，基于临床可验证的合成患者原型生成高真实感、长周期医疗轨迹；2) 生成约2000个会话、16000轮交互的大规模、专家验证数据集；3) 提出"边构建边评估"的流式评估协议，模拟生产环境中动态记忆积累过程；4) 形式化定义并系统研究"记忆饱和"现象。
AI.result: 构建了MedMemoryBench数据集和评估框架，通过全面基准测试揭示了主流架构在复杂医疗推理和噪声鲁棒性方面的严重瓶颈，特别是记忆饱和导致信息持续涌入时检索和推理鲁棒性显著退化。
AI.conclusion: MedMemoryBench通过暴露现有代理在医疗记忆管理中的根本缺陷，为开发健壮、可投入生产的医疗代理奠定了关键基础。
idea_en: Human-agent collaborative pipeline for synthesizing clinically-grounded, long-horizon medical trajectories based on synthetic patient archetypes
"Evaluate-while-constructing" streaming assessment protocol for dynamically mirroring memory accumulation in production environments
Formalized characterization and systematic investigation of memory saturation phenomenon in healthcare agents
Noise resilience evaluation methodology for healthcare agent memory systems under sustained information influx
idea_ch: 基于合成患者原型的人机协作管道，用于生成临床可验证的长周期医疗轨迹数据
"边构建边评估"流式评估协议，动态模拟生产环境中的记忆积累过程
医疗代理系统中记忆饱和现象的规范化定义与系统性研究方法
在持续信息涌入下医疗代理记忆系统的噪声鲁棒性评估方法

title: On-Policy Self-Evolution via Failure Trajectories for Agentic Safety Alignment
summary: Tool-using LLM agents fail through trajectories rather than only final responses, as they may execute unsafe tool calls, follow injected instructions, comply with harmful requests, or over-refuse benign tasks despite producing a seemingly safe answer. Existing safety-alignment signals are largely response-level or off-policy, and often incur a safety-utility trade-off: improving agent safety comes at the cost of degraded task performance. Such sparse and single-objective rewards severely limit real-world usability. To bridge this gap, we propose FATE, an on-policy self-evolving framework that transforms verifier-scored failures into repair supervision without expert demonstrations. For each failure, the same policy proposes repair candidates, which are then re-scored by verifiers and filtered across security, utility, over-refusal control, and trajectory validity. This dense trajectory-level information is then used as a supervision signal for agent self-evolution. During this process, we further introduce Pareto-Front Policy Optimization (PFPO), combining supervised warmup with Pareto-aware policy optimization to preserve safety-utility trade-offs. Experiments on AgentDojo, AgentHarm, and ATBench show that FATE improves safety across different models and scales while preserving useful behavior. Compared with strong baselines, FATE reduces attack success rate by 33.5%, harmful compliance by 82.6%, and improves external trajectory-safety diagnosis by 6.5%. These results suggest that failed trajectories can provide structured repair supervision for safer self-evolving agents.

AI.tldr: 提出FATE框架，通过将验证器评分的失败轨迹转化为修复监督信号，结合Pareto前沿策略优化(PFPO)，实现智能体在线自我进化，在不牺牲任务性能的前提下提升LLM智能体的安全性。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM智能体的安全对齐主要依赖响应级或离策略信号，导致安全性与实用性之间存在权衡，且稀疏的单目标奖励严重限制了实际应用。
AI.method: 1) 对每个失败轨迹，使用同一策略生成修复候选项；2) 经验证器在安全性、实用性、过度拒绝控制和轨迹有效性四个维度重新评分和过滤；3) 将稠密的轨迹级信息作为监督信号进行自我进化；4) 引入Pareto前沿策略优化(PFPO)，结合监督预热和Pareto感知策略优化来维护安全-效用权衡。
AI.result: 在AgentDojo、AgentHarm和ATBench上，FATE将攻击成功率降低33.5%，有害遵从性降低82.6%，外部轨迹安全诊断提升6.5%。
AI.conclusion: 失败的轨迹可以为更安全的自我进化智能体提供结构化的修复监督信号。
idea_en: A self-evolving framework for LLM agents that transforms verifier-scored failed trajectories into structured repair supervision signals without requiring expert demonstrations.
Pareto-Front Policy Optimization (PFPO) combining supervised warmup with Pareto-aware policy optimization to jointly preserve safety and utility trade-offs in agent behavior.
A multi-dimensional dense trajectory-level filtering mechanism that evaluates repair candidates across security, utility, over-refusal control, and trajectory validity dimensions.
On-policy self-evolution method using the same policy to propose repair candidates for its own failures, enabling closed-loop agent improvement without external supervision.
A trajectory-level safety-utility joint optimization framework that overcomes the sparse single-objective reward limitation in existing agent safety alignment approaches.
idea_ch: 一种将验证器评分的失败轨迹转化为结构化修复监督信号的LLM智能体自我进化框架，无需专家示范。
Pareto前沿策略优化(PFPO)：结合监督预热与Pareto感知策略优化，在智能体行为中同时维护安全性与实用性的权衡。
多维度稠密轨迹级过滤机制：从安全性、实用性、过度拒绝控制和轨迹有效性四个维度对修复候选项进行评分和筛选。
同策略自我进化方法：使用同一策略为其自身失败生成修复候选项，实现无需外部监督的闭环智能体改进。
一种轨迹级安全-效用联合优化框架，克服了现有智能体安全对齐方法中稀疏单目标奖励的局限性。

title: From Clever Hans to Scientific Discovery: Interpreting EEG Foundational Transformers with LRP
summary: Emerging foundation models (FMs) in electroencephalography (EEG) promise a path to scale deep learning in diagnostics and brain-computer interfaces despite data scarcity, yet their opaque nature remains a barrier to wider adoption. We investigate attention-aware Layer-wise relevance propagation (LRP) as a post-hoc attribution method for EEG-FMs, extending LRP's use on convolutional neural network (CNN)-based EEG models to the Transformer architectures that current FMs are based on. We find that LRP can both verify EEG-FM decisions and surface novel, biologically plausible hypotheses from them. In motor imagery, it unmasks 'Clever Hans' behavior where models prioritize task correlated ocular signals over the intended motor correlates. In a naturalistic paradigm for affect prediction, it reveals a recurring reliance on a central electrode cluster, suggesting a candidate sensorimotor signature of arousal. Though heatmap interpretation remains ambiguous in this complex domain, the results position LRP as a tool for both verification and exploration of EEG-FMs, a role that will grow in both importance and discovery potential as the underlying models mature.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了注意力感知的层间相关性传播（LRP）作为脑电图基础模型（EEG-FMs）的事后归因方法，发现LRP既能验证模型决策，又能揭示新的生物学假设，例如在运动想象任务中发现"聪明汉斯"行为（模型优先关注眼动信号而非运动相关信号），以及在自然情感预测中揭示中央电极簇的重复依赖模式。
AI.motivation: 脑电图基础模型（EEG-FMs）在诊断和脑机接口领域有巨大潜力，但其不透明的"黑箱"特性阻碍了广泛应用。需要一种可解释性方法，既能验证模型决策的合理性，又能从模型中发现新的生物学见解。
AI.method: 将原本用于CNN的层间相关性传播（LRP）方法扩展应用到基于Transformer架构的EEG基础模型上，作为事后归因工具，通过注意力感知机制分析模型决策依据。
AI.result: 在运动想象任务中，LRP揭示了模型依赖眼动信号（"聪明汉斯"行为）而非实际运动相关信号做出决策；在自然情感预测任务中，发现模型反复依赖中央电极簇，提示可能的传感器运动唤醒特征。
AI.conclusion: LRP可作为EEG基础模型验证和探索的有效工具，尽管热力图解释在复杂领域仍存在模糊性，但随着模型成熟，其重要性和发现潜力将不断增长。
idea_en: Attention-aware Layer-wise Relevance Propagation (LRP) method adapted for Transformer-based EEG foundation models, enabling post-hoc attribution analysis of model decisions in brain-computer interfaces.

System for detecting 'Clever Hans' behavior in EEG-based models by using LRP to identify when models prioritize task-correlated confounding signals (e.g., ocular signals) over intended neural correlates.
Method for identifying biological plausible neural signatures from EEG foundation models using LRP attribution, such as central electrode cluster sensorimotor patterns for arousal prediction.
Post-hoc verification framework for EEG foundation models that combines attention mechanisms with relevance propagation to validate model decision rationale against known physiological knowledge.
LRP-based electrode-level attribution technique that reveals spatially localized neural correlates from Transformer-based EEG models in naturalistic paradigms.
idea_ch: 基于注意力感知的层间相关性传播（LRP）方法，专为Transformer架构的EEG基础模型适配，实现脑机接口中模型决策的事后归因分析。
利用LRP检测EEG模型中'聪明汉斯'行为的系统，识别模型何时优先使用任务相关混淆信号（如眼动信号）而非预期的神经相关性信号做出决策。
从EEG基础模型中通过LRP归因识别生物学可信神经特征的方法，例如用于唤醒预测的中央电极簇感觉运动模式。
EEG基础模型的事后验证框架，结合注意力机制与相关性传播，根据已知生理学知识验证模型决策的合理性。
基于LRP的电极级归因技术，从基于Transformer的EEG模型中在自然范式下揭示空间定位的神经相关性特征。

title: Toward Modeling Player-Specific Chess Behaviors
summary: While artificial intelligence has achieved superhuman performance in chess, developing models that accurately emulate the individualized decision-making styles of human players remains a significant challenge. Existing human-like chess models capture general population behaviors based on skill levels but fail to reproduce the behavioral characteristics of specific historical champions. Furthermore, the standard evaluation metric, move accuracy, inherently penalizes natural human variance and ignores long-term behavioral consistency, leading to an incomplete assessment of stylistic fidelity. To address these limitations, an architecture is proposed that adapts the unified Maia-2 model to champion-specific embeddings, further enhanced by the integration of a limited Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS) process to enrich tactical exploration during move selection. To robustly evaluate this approach, a novel behavioral metric based on the Jensen-Shannon divergence is introduced. By compressing high-dimensional board representations into a latent space using an AutoEncoder and Uniform Manifold Approximation and Projection (UMAP), move distributions are discretized on a common grid to compare behavioral similarities. Results across 16 historical world champions indicate that while integrating MCTS decreases standard move accuracy, it improves stylistic alignment according to the proposed metric, substantially reducing the average Jensen-Shannon divergence. Ultimately, the proposed metric successfully discriminates between individual players and provides promising evidence toward more comprehensive evaluations of behavioral alignment between players and AI models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于Maia-2架构并融合有限蒙特卡洛树搜索(MCTS)的方法，用于模拟历史国际象棋冠军的个性化决策风格；同时引入基于Jensen-Shannon散度的新行为度量标准，更全面地评估AI模型与人类玩家的行为对齐度。
AI.motivation: 现有AI在象棋领域已达超人类水平，但缺乏能准确模仿特定历史冠军个性化决策风格的模型；标准评估指标（走棋准确率）惩罚自然人类变异性，忽略长期行为一致性，无法全面评估风格保真度。
AI.method: 1) 将统一Maia-2模型适配到冠军特定嵌入；2) 集成有限MCTS过程增强战术探索；3) 提出基于Jensen-Shannon散度的新行为度量，利用AutoEncoder和UMAP将高维棋盘表示压缩到潜在空间，在公共网格上离散化走棋分布以比较行为相似性。
AI.result: 对16位历史世界冠军的测试表明：集成MCTS虽降低了标准走棋准确率，但根据新提出的度量标准提高了风格对齐度，显著降低了平均Jensen-Shannon散度。
AI.conclusion: 新提出的度量标准能成功区分个体玩家，为更全面评估玩家与AI模型之间的行为对齐提供了有前景的证据。
idea_en: A method for generating champion-specific chess move embeddings by adapting a unified Maia-2 model with limited MCTS integration, enabling personalized decision-making simulation for specific historical champions.

A behavioral similarity metric based on Jensen-Shannon divergence that compresses high-dimensional board representations into a latent space using AutoEncoder and UMAP, then discretizes move distributions on a common grid for comparison.
A hybrid architecture combining champion-specific embeddings with limited-depth Monte Carlo Tree Search to balance stylistic fidelity and tactical exploration in chess AI.
A technique for discretizing chess move distributions on a common grid via dimensionality reduction (AutoEncoder + UMAP) to enable fair comparison of diverse playing styles.
A method for evaluating AI-human behavioral alignment in chess using Jensen-Shannon divergence on compressed latent representations, moving beyond traditional move accuracy metrics.
idea_ch: 一种通过将统一Maia-2模型适配到冠军特定嵌入并集成有限MCTS的方法，用于生成特定历史冠军的个性化象棋走棋模拟。
一种基于Jensen-Shannon散度的行为相似度度量方法，利用AutoEncoder和UMAP将高维棋盘表示压缩到潜在空间，在公共网格上离散化走棋分布以进行比较。
一种结合冠军特定嵌入与有限深度蒙特卡洛树搜索的混合架构，平衡象棋AI的风格保真度与战术探索能力。
一种通过降维技术（AutoEncoder + UMAP）将象棋走棋分布离散化到公共网格的方法，实现对不同棋风的公平比较。
一种利用压缩潜在表示上的Jensen-Shannon散度评估AI-人类行为对齐度的方法，超越了传统走棋准确率度量的局限。

title: Rethinking Supervision Granularity: Segment-Level Learning for LLM-Based Theorem Proving
summary: Automated theorem proving with large language models in Lean 4 is commonly approached through either step-level tactic prediction with tree search or whole-proof generation. These two paradigms represent opposite granularities for constructing supervised training data: the former provides dense local signals but may fragment coherent proof processes, while the latter preserves global structure but requires complex end-to-end generation. In this paper, we revisit supervision granularity as a training set construction problem over proof trajectories and propose segment-level supervision, a training data construction strategy that extracts locally coherent proof segments for training policy models. We further reuse the same strategy at inference time to trigger short rollouts for existing step-level models. When trained with segment-level supervision on STP, LeanWorkbook, and NuminaMath-LEAN, the resulting policy models achieve proof success rates of 64.84%, 60.90%, and 66.31% on miniF2F, respectively, consistently outperforming both step-level and whole-proof baselines. Goal-aware rollout further improves existing step-level provers while reducing inference costs. It increases the proof success rate of BFS-Prover-V2-7B from 68.77% to 70.74% and that of InternLM2.5-StepProver from 59.59% to 60.33%, showing that appropriate supervision granularity better aligns model learning with proof structure and search. Code and models are available at https://github.com/NJUDeepEngine/SEG-ATP.

AI.tldr: 提出段级监督策略，在步级预测和全证明生成之间取得平衡，通过提取局部连贯证明段训练策略模型并在推理时复用进行短 rollout，显著提升定理证明成功率和效率。
AI.motivation: 步级预测提供密集局部信号但可能割裂连贯的证明过程，全证明生成保留全局结构但需要复杂的端到端生成，两者各有利弊，需要一种介于两者之间的监督粒度。
AI.method: 提出段级监督策略，将定理证明轨迹分割为局部连贯的证明段作为训练数据；在推理时复用该策略触发短 rollout；引入目标感知展开机制优化搜索过程。
AI.result: 在STP、LeanWorkbook、NuminaMath-LEAN上训练的模型在miniF2F上分别达到64.84%、60.90%和66.31%的证明成功率，一致优于步级和全证明基线；目标感知展开将BFS-Prover-V2-7B从68.77%提升至70.74%，InternLM2.5-StepProver从59.59%提升至60.33%。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出了一种新的监督粒度——段级监督（segment-level supervision），在定理证明的步级预测和全证明生成之间取得了平衡，通过提取局部连贯的证明段来训练策略模型，并在推理时复用该策略进行短 rollout，从而在多个基准上一致优于步级和全证明基线，同时降低推理成本。
idea_en: 1. Segment-level supervision training method: extracting locally coherent proof segments (rather than individual steps or entire proofs) from theorem proving trajectories as supervised training data for policy models, balancing dense local signals with global structural integrity.

2. Inference-time short rollout strategy: reusing the segment-level segmentation strategy from training at inference time to trigger short rollouts for existing step-level models, reducing search tree depth and inference costs.

3. Goal-aware rollout mechanism: incorporating goal-awareness during rollout to make generated proof segments more targeted toward the theorem to be proved, improving both proof success rate and efficiency.
idea_ch: 1. 段级监督训练方法：从定理证明轨迹中提取局部连贯的证明段（而非单个步骤或整个证明）作为监督数据训练策略模型，兼顾局部信号密度与全局结构完整性。
2. 推理时短 rollout 策略：在推理阶段复用训练时的段级切分策略，触发现有步级模型进行短步长展开，减少搜索树深度并降低推理成本。
3. 目标感知展开（Goal-aware rollout）：在 rollout 过程中引入目标感知机制，使模型生成的证明段更有针对性地朝向待证明目标，提升证明成功率和效率。

title: Rethinking Positional Encoding for Neural Vehicle Routing
summary: Transformer-based models have become the dominant paradigm for neural combinatorial optimization (NCO) of vehicle routing problems (VRPs), yet the role of positional encoding (PE) in these architectures remains largely unexplored. Unlike natural language, where tokens are uniformly spaced on a line, routing solutions exhibit several properties that render standard NLP positional encodings inadequate. In this work, we formalize three such structural properties that a routing-aware PE should respect, namely anisometric node distances, cyclic and direction-aware topology, and hierarchical depot-anchored global multi-route structure, combining them with a unifying design principle of geometric grounding. Guided by these criteria, we analyze and compare PE methods spanning NLP, graph-transformer, and routing-specific families, and propose a hierarchical anisometric PE that combines a distance-indexed, circularly consistent in-route encoding with a depot-anchored angular cross-route encoding. Extensive experiments across diverse VRP variants demonstrate that geometry-grounded PE consistently outperforms index-based alternatives, with gains that transfer across problem variants, model architectures, and distribution shifts.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种面向车辆路径问题的几何位置编码方法，该编码考虑了节点间的非等距、循环方向感知和层次化多路径结构特性，实验证明其优于传统索引位置编码。
AI.motivation: 现有Transformer模型在神经组合优化中占主导地位，但位置编码的作用尚未被充分探索。标准的NLP位置编码不适合路由问题，因为路由解具有非等距节点距离、循环方向感知拓扑和层次化多路径结构等独特属性。
AI.method: 形式化了路由感知位置编码应满足的三种结构属性：非等距节点距离、循环方向感知拓扑、层次化仓库锚定的全局多路径结构。提出层次化非等距位置编码，结合距离索引的循环一致路径内编码和仓库锚定的角度跨路径编码。
AI.result: 在多种VRP变体上的大量实验表明，基于几何的位置编码一致优于基于索引的替代方案，且增益可跨问题变体、模型架构和分布偏移迁移。
AI.conclusion: 几何基础的位置编码对于神经组合优化中的路由问题至关重要，提出的编码方法在多个维度上展现出优越性和泛化能力。
idea_en: A hierarchical anisometric positional encoding method for vehicle routing problems, combining distance-indexed circularly consistent in-route encoding with depot-anchored angular cross-route encoding
A geometric grounding design principle for positional encoding in neural combinatorial optimization that respects anisometric node distances
A cyclic and direction-aware positional encoding topology for routing solutions in Transformer architectures
A depot-anchored hierarchical global multi-route structure encoding method for multi-vehicle routing problems
A cross-distribution-shift transferable positional encoding scheme for neural combinatorial optimization models
idea_ch: 一种面向车辆路径问题的层次化非等距位置编码方法，结合距离索引的循环一致路径内编码和仓库锚定的角度跨路径编码
一种神经组合优化中基于几何基础的位置编码设计原则，尊重节点间的非等距距离特性
一种面向Transformer架构中路由解结构的循环方向感知位置编码拓扑方法
一种面向多车辆路径问题的仓库锚定层次化全局多路径结构编码方法
一种可跨分布偏移迁移的神经组合优化位置编码方案

title: Domain Restriction via Multi SAE Layer Transitions
summary: The general-purpose nature of Large Language Models (LLMs) presents a significant challenge for domain-specific applications, often leading to out-of-domain (OOD) interactions that undermine the provider's intent. Existing methods for detecting such scenarios treat the LLM as an uninterpretable black box and overlook the internal processing of inputs. In this work we show that layer transitions provide a promising avenue for extracting domain-specific signature. Specifically, we present several lightweight ways of learning on internal dynamics encoded using a sparse autoencoder (SAE) that exhibit great capability in distinguishing OOD texts. Building on top of SAEs representation transitions enables us to better interpret the LLM internal evolution of input processing and shed light on its decisions. We provide a comprehensive analysis of the method and benchmark it with the gemma-2 2B and 9B models. Our results emphasize the efficacy of the internal process in capturing fine-grained input-related details.

AI.tldr: 本文提出利用大语言模型内部层间表征的动态变化（通过稀疏自编码器提取），进行领域外文本检测，方法轻量且可解释性强。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型在领域特定应用中常遇到超出域（OOD）交互问题，现有检测方法将LLM视为黑盒，忽略了输入处理的内部机制，缺乏可解释性和高效性。
AI.method: 利用稀疏自编码器（SAE）提取LLM各层的内部表征，学习层间表征转换的动态特征，以此构建轻量级OOD文本检测器。
AI.result: 在gemma-2 2B和9B模型上进行了全面实验，结果表明基于内部层间动态的方法能有效捕捉细粒度输入相关细节，显著提升OOD检测性能。
AI.conclusion: LLM内部层间转换蕴含领域特异性签名，基于SAE的表征转换学习不仅提升了OOD检测效果，还为理解LLM内部决策过程提供了可解释性视角。
idea_en: A method for out-of-domain text detection by extracting domain-specific signatures from layer transitions of LLMs using sparse autoencoders (SAEs).
A lightweight learning framework that utilizes internal dynamic representations across LLM layers, encoded via SAE, to distinguish OOD inputs without full model fine-tuning.
A technique for interpreting LLM internal decision processes by analyzing SAE-based representation transitions between successive layers.
idea_ch: 基于稀疏自编码器提取大语言模型层间转换的领域特异性签名，用于超出域文本检测的方法。
利用SAE编码的LLM层间动态表征进行轻量级学习，无需完整模型微调即可高效区分OOD输入的框架。
通过分析基于SAE的层间表征转换来揭示大语言模型内部决策过程的解释性技术。

title: When Simulation Lies: A Sim-to-Real Benchmark and Domain-Randomized RL Recipe for Tool-Use Agents
comment: Dataset, code, and benchmark leaderboard are available at https://github.com/WillChow66/robustbench-tc-release.git and https://huggingface.co/spaces/willchow66/robustbench-tc-leaderboard
summary: Tool-use language agents are evaluated on benchmarks that assume clean inputs, unambiguous tool registries, and reliable APIs. Real deployments violate all these assumptions: user typos propagate into hallucinated tool names, a misconfigured request timeout can stall an agent indefinitely, and duplicate tool names across servers can freeze an SDK. We study these failures as a sim-to-real gap in the tool-use partially observable Markov decision process (POMDP), where deployment noise enters through the observation, action space, reward-relevant metadata, or transition dynamics. We introduce RobustBench-TC, a benchmark with 22 perturbation types organized by these four POMDP components, each grounded in a verified GitHub issue or documented tool-calling failure. Across 21 models from 1.5B to 32B parameters (including the closed-source o4-mini), the robustness profile is sharply uneven: observation perturbations reduce accuracy by less than 5%, while reward-relevant and transition perturbations reduce accuracy by roughly 40% and 30%, respectively; scale alone does not close these gaps. We then propose ToolRL-DR, a domain-randomization reinforcement learning (RL) recipe that trains a tool-use agent on perturbation-augmented trajectories spanning the three statically encodable POMDP components. On a 3B backbone, ToolRL-DR-Full retains roughly three-quarters of clean accuracy and reaches an aggregate perturbed accuracy comparable to open-source 14B function-calling baselines while substantially narrowing the gap to o4-mini. It closes approximately 27% of the Transition gap despite never seeing transition perturbations in training, suggesting that RL on adversarial static tool-use inputs induces a more persistent retry policy that transfers to unseen runtime failures. The dataset, code and benchmark leaderboard are publicly available.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了工具型语言模型从仿真环境部署到真实世界时面临的鲁棒性问题，提出了包含22种扰动类型的RobustBench-TC基准测试，以及一种基于域随机化强化学习（ToolRL-DR）的训练方法，使3B参数模型在扰动环境下达到接近14B开源模型和闭源o4-mini的鲁棒性水平。
AI.motivation: 现有工具使用语言模型评测假设输入干净、工具注册表无歧义、API可靠，但真实部署中这些假设均被违反（如用户拼写错误、超时配置失误、工具名冲突等），存在严重的仿真到现实（sim-to-real）差距。
AI.method: 将部署噪声建模为工具使用POMDP中四个组件的扰动（观测、动作空间、奖励相关元数据、转移动力学），构建包含22种扰动类型的RobustBench-TC基准；提出ToolRL-DR，一种域随机化强化学习方法，在扰动增强轨迹上训练工具使用智能体。
AI.result: 观测扰动仅降低<5%准确率，奖励相关和转移扰动分别降低约40%和30%；规模本身不能消除鲁棒性差距；ToolRL-DR-Full在3B骨干上保留约3/4干净准确率，达到接近14B开源基线和o4-mini的扰动准确率，并弥合约27%的转移扰动差距。
AI.conclusion: 域随机化强化学习能有效提升工具使用语言模型在真实部署噪声下的鲁棒性，且对未见过的运行时故障类型也具有泛化能力。
idea_en: A domain-randomization reinforcement learning (RL) method (ToolRL-DR) that trains tool-use agents on perturbation-augmented trajectories spanning multiple POMDP components, enabling robust tool calling under real-world deployment noise.

A benchmark (RobustBench-TC) with 22 perturbation types organized by four POMDP components (observation, action space, reward-relevant metadata, transition dynamics), each grounded in verified GitHub issues or documented tool-calling failures.
A method that induces persistent retry policy via RL on adversarial static tool-use inputs, which transfers to unseen runtime transition failures without explicit transition perturbation training.
A system that classifies deployment noise in tool-use language agents into POMDP component categories and applies targeted perturbations for robustness evaluation.

A training recipe combining clean data with multiple types of perturbed trajectories that preserves approximately three-quarters of clean accuracy while substantially improving perturbed accuracy on small (3B) backbone models.
idea_ch: 一种域随机化强化学习方法（ToolRL-DR），通过在多个POMDP组件上使用扰动增强轨迹训练工具使用智能体，使其在真实部署噪声下具备鲁棒工具调用能力。
一个包含22种扰动类型的基准测试（RobustBench-TC），按四个POMDP组件（观测、动作空间、奖励相关元数据、转移动力学）组织，每种扰动均基于已验证的GitHub问题或文档化工具调用失败案例。
一种通过对抗性静态工具输入上的强化学习诱发持久重试策略的方法，该方法无需显式转移扰动训练即可泛化到未见过的运行时转移故障。
一种将工具使用语言模型部署噪声分类为POMDP组件类别并进行针对性扰动评估的系统。
一种结合干净数据与多种类型扰动轨迹的训练方案，在3B骨干模型上保留约3/4的干净准确率，同时大幅提升扰动环境下的准确率。

title: From Noise to Diversity: Random Embedding Injection in LLM Reasoning
summary: Recent soft prompt research has tried to improve reasoning by inserting trained vectors into LLM inputs, yet whether the gain comes from the learned content or from the act of injection itself has not been carefully separated. We study Random Soft Prompts (RSPs), which drop the training step entirely and append a freshly drawn sequence of random embedding vectors to the input. Each RSP vector is sampled from an isotropic Gaussian fitted to the entrywise mean and variance of the pretrained embedding table; the sequence carries no learned content, and yet reaches accuracy comparable to optimized soft prompts on math reasoning benchmarks in several settings. The mechanism unfolds in two stages: because attention has to absorb a never-seen-before random position, the distribution over the first few generated tokens flattens and reasoning trajectories branch, and as generation continues this influence dilutes naturally so the response commits to a single completion. We show that during inference RSPs lift early-stage token diversity and, combined with temperature sampling, widen Pass@N, the probability that at least one out of N attempts is correct. Beyond inference, we carry the same effect into DAPO training and demonstrate practical gains. Our contributions are: (i) RSP isolates the simplest form of soft prompt -- training-free, freshly resampled -- providing a unified lens for the structural effect of injection that variants otherwise differing in training and form all share; (ii) a theoretical and empirical validation of the underlying mechanism; and (iii) an extension from inference to training.

AI.tldr: 随机软提示（RSP）在不经训练的情况下，通过向输入中注入随机嵌入向量，达到与优化软提示相当的数学推理性能。其机制是通过引入随机位置分散注意力、提升早期token多样性，从而增加正确推理路径的概率。
AI.motivation: 现有软提示研究未能区分性能提升是来自学习到的内容还是注入行为本身。作者旨在分离这一效应，探索无训练的随机提示是否也能带来推理增益。
AI.method: 从预训练嵌入表的均值和方差拟合各向同性高斯分布，从中采样随机嵌入向量序列，直接拼接到输入中。不进行任何训练。通过分析注意力分布、token多样性等解释机制。
AI.result: RSP在数学推理基准上达到与优化软提示相当的准确率；提升了早期token多样性和Pass@N；将相同机制扩展到DAPO训练中并取得实际收益。
AI.conclusion: 提示注入的结构性效应本身就能带来性能提升，无需依赖学习内容。RSP提供了一个统一的视角来理解各类软提示变体中共有的注入效应。
idea_en: A training-free soft prompt method using randomly sampled embedding vectors fitted to the statistics of a pretrained embedding table, inserted into LLM input to improve reasoning accuracy.
A mechanism of improving Pass@N by injecting random soft prompts to flatten early-stage token distribution and diversify reasoning trajectories during inference.
A combined approach of random soft prompts with temperature sampling to widen the probability of at least one correct answer among multiple attempts.
A method of applying random soft prompts during DAPO reinforcement learning training to enhance training efficiency and performance.
A unified framework for analyzing the structural effects of prompt injection across different soft prompt variants by isolating the injection act from learned content.
idea_ch: 一种无训练的软提示方法，从预训练嵌入表的统计量拟合的各向同性高斯分布中采样随机嵌入向量序列，插入到LLM输入中以提高推理准确率。
一种通过注入随机软提示来扁平化早期token分布、多样化推理轨迹，从而在推理阶段提升Pass@N的机制。
一种随机软提示与温度采样相结合的方法，增加多次尝试中至少一次正确的概率。
一种在DAPO强化学习训练过程中应用随机软提示以增强训练效率和性能的方法。
一种统一的分析框架，通过将注入行为与学习内容分离，研究不同软提示变体中提示注入的结构性效应。

title: Counterfactual Trace Auditing of LLM Agent Skills
comment: Code and data are available at https://github.com/WillChow66/CTA.git
summary: Large Language Model agents are increasingly augmented with agent skills. Current evaluation methods for skills remain limited. Most deployed benchmarks report only pass rate before and after a skill is attached, treating the skill as a black box change to agent behavior. We introduce Counterfactual Trace Auditing (CTA), a framework for measuring how a skill changes agent behavior. CTA pairs each with skill agent trace with a without skill counterpart on the same task, segments both traces into goal directed phases, aligns the phases, and emits structured Skill Influence Pattern (SIP) annotations. These annotations describe the behavioral effect of a skill rather than only its task outcome. We instantiate CTA on SWE-Skills-Bench with Claude across 49 software engineering tasks. The resulting audit reveals a clear evaluation gap. Pass rate changes by only +0.3 percentage points on average, suggesting little aggregate effect. Yet CTA identifies 522 SIP instances across the same paired traces, showing that the skills substantially reshape agent behavior even when pass rate is nearly unchanged. The audit also separates several recurring effects that pass rate cannot detect, including literal template copying, off task artifact creation, excess planning, and task recovery. Three findings emerge. First, high baseline tasks contain most of the observed skill effects, although their pass rate is already saturated and therefore cannot reflect those effects. Second, tasks with moderate baseline performance show the most recoverable gain, but often at substantially higher token cost. Third, the dominant SIP type can be identified by baseline bucket: surface anchoring is most common on ceiling tasks and edge-case prompting is most common on mid-range and floor tasks. These regularities turn informal failure mode observations into reproducible behavioral measurements.

AI.tldr: 本文提出反事实轨迹审计（CTA）框架，通过对比有/无技能加持的智能体行为轨迹，系统测量技能对智能体行为的影响，揭示了仅用通过率评估技能的严重不足。
AI.motivation: 现有技能评估方法仅报告通过率变化，将技能视为黑箱，无法揭示技能如何具体改变智能体行为，存在评估盲区。
AI.method: CTA框架：为每个带技能轨迹配对无技能对照轨迹，将两者分割为目标导向阶段并对齐，输出结构化技能影响模式（SIP）标注。
AI.result: 在49个软件工程任务上，通过率仅变化+0.3个百分点，但CTA识别出522个SIP实例，揭示了文字模板复制、离题工件创建、过度规划、任务恢复等通过率无法检测的行为效应。
AI.conclusion: 通过率评估严重低估技能影响；高基线任务中技能效应最多但通过率已饱和；中等基线任务有最大可恢复增益但token成本高；不同基线区间主导SIP类型不同。
idea_en: Counterfactual Trace Auditing (CTA) framework for measuring how a skill changes agent behavior by pairing with-skill and without-skill agent traces on the same task
Skill Influence Pattern (SIP) annotations that describe behavioral effect of a skill rather than only task outcome
Method for segmenting and aligning goal-directed phases across paired with/without skill agent traces
Systematic identification of recurring skill effects undetectable by pass rate: literal template copying, off-task artifact creation, excess planning, and task recovery
Baseline-bucket based dominant SIP type prediction: surface anchoring for ceiling tasks, edge-case prompting for mid-range and floor tasks
idea_ch: 反事实轨迹审计（CTA）框架：在同一任务上配对带技能和不带技能的智能体轨迹，测量技能如何改变智能体行为
技能影响模式（SIP）标注：描述技能的行为效应而非仅任务结果的结构化标注方法
配对轨迹的阶段性分割与对齐方法：将有/无技能轨迹分割为目标导向阶段并对齐
通过率无法检测的四种技能效应系统识别：文字模板复制、离题工件创建、过度规划、任务恢复
基于基线桶的主导SIP类型预测方法：天花板任务以表面锚定为主，中低基线任务以边缘案例提示为主

title: Assessing and Mitigating Miscalibration in LLM-Based Social Science Measurement
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used in social science as scalable measurement tools for converting unstructured text into variables that can enter standard empirical designs. Measurement validity demands more than high average accuracy, which requires well calibrated confidence that faithfully reflects the empirical probability of each measurement being correct. This paper studies the model miscalibration in LLM-based social science measurement. We begin with a case study on FOMC and show that confidence based filtering can change downstream regression estimates when LLM confidence is miscalibrated. We then audit calibration across 14 social science constructs covering both proprietary models, including GPT-5-mini, DeepSeek-V3.2, and open source models. Across tasks and model families, reported confidence is poorly aligned with tolerance-based correctness. As a simple mitigation, we propose a soft label distillation pipeline for calibrating Bert with LLM. The method converts an LLM score and its verbalized confidence into a soft target distribution, then trains a smaller discriminative classifier on encoder models for these targets. Averaged across datasets, this approach reduces ECE by 43.2\% and Brier by 34.0\%. These results suggest that LLM-based social science pipelines should treat calibration as part of measurement validity, rather than as an optional post-processing concern.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了大语言模型（LLM）在社会科学测量中的校准问题，发现LLM报告的信心与真实正确率之间存在严重失配，并提出了一种软标签蒸馏管道来校准BERT分类器，平均将ECE降低43.2%，Brier分数降低34.0%。
AI.motivation: LLM被广泛用于社会科学中的文本测量工具，但测量效度要求信心校准良好，而现有LLM在报告置信度时存在系统性失准，可能导致下游回归分析产生偏误。
AI.method: 首先通过FOMC案例研究展示信心过滤对回归估计的影响；然后在14个社会科学构念上审计多种LLM（GPT-5-mini、DeepSeek-V3.2及开源模型）的校准性能；最后提出软标签蒸馏管道：将LLM的分数和口头化信心转换为软目标分布，训练小型判别分类器（BERT）去拟合这些目标。
AI.result: 跨数据集平均，该方法将期望校准误差（ECE）降低43.2%，Brier分数降低34.0%，显著改善了校准性能。
AI.conclusion: 基于LLM的社会科学测量流程应将校准视为测量效度的组成部分，而非可选的后期处理步骤。
idea_en: Soft label distillation pipeline for calibrating a smaller discriminative classifier (e.g., BERT) using LLM scores and verbalized confidence as soft target distributions.
Confidence-based filtering bias detection method for quantifying how miscalibrated LLM confidence affects downstream regression estimates in social science measurement.
Cross-task calibration auditing framework across 14 social science constructs for evaluating confidence-calibration alignment in proprietary and open-source LLMs.
Tolerance-based correctness metric for assessing LLM confidence calibration beyond average accuracy in text measurement tasks.
idea_ch: 一种软标签蒸馏管道：将LLM的评分及其口头化信心转换为软目标分布，用于训练小型判别分类器（如BERT），实现校准性能的显著提升。
基于信心过滤的偏误检测方法：通过量化LLM信心失准时信心过滤如何改变下游回归估计，揭示测量效度问题。
跨任务校准审计框架：覆盖14个社会科学构念，系统评估闭源模型（GPT-5-mini、DeepSeek-V3.2）和开源模型的信心-校准对齐情况。
基于容差正确性的校准评估指标：超越平均准确率，从容差角度评估LLM在文本测量任务中的信心校准水平。

title: On the Limitations of Large Language Models for Conceptual Database Modeling
summary: This article analyzes the use of Large Language Models (LLMs) as support for the conceptual modeling of relational databases through the automatic generation of Entity-Relationship (ER) diagrams from natural language requirements. The approach combines different language models with prompt engineering techniques to evaluate their ability to identify entities, relationships, and attributes in a conceptually consistent manner. The experimental evaluation involved three LLMs, each subjected to three prompting techniques (Zero-Shot, Chain of Thought, and Chain of Thought + Verifier), applied to the same requirements scenario with progressively increasing complexity. The generated diagrams were qualitatively analyzed through direct comparison with the textual requirements, considering the structural and semantic adherence of the modeled elements. The results indicate that, although LLMs show reasonable performance in less complex scenarios, their reliability decreases as the complexity of the requirements increases, with a rise in inconsistencies, ambiguities, and failures in representing constraints. These findings reinforce that, in their current state, LLMs are not sufficiently mature for reliable use in complex scenarios, and the cost of validation may offset the apparent productivity gains.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了使用大语言模型（LLMs）从自然语言需求自动生成ER图，实验发现LLMs在简单场景表现尚可，但在复杂场景下可靠性显著下降，存在不一致、歧义和约束表示失败等问题。
AI.motivation: 探索LLMs在关系数据库概念建模中的自动化潜力，评估其能否可靠地从自然语言需求中识别实体、关系和属性，生成实体关系图。
AI.method: 对三种LLM应用三种提示工程技术（Zero-Shot、Chain of Thought、Chain of Thought + Verifier），在渐进复杂度的需求场景下生成ER图，并通过与文本需求的直接比较进行定性分析。
AI.result: LLMs在低复杂度场景下表现合理，但随着需求复杂度增加，可靠性下降，出现更多不一致性、歧义和约束表示失败。
AI.conclusion: 当前LLMs在复杂场景下尚未足够成熟，验证成本可能抵消其带来的生产力提升。
idea_en: A method for generating Entity-Relationship diagrams from natural language requirements using LLMs with Chain of Thought + Verifier prompting technique to improve structural consistency.
A prompt engineering framework combining Chain of Thought reasoning with a verification module for validating conceptual modeling outputs from LLMs.
An automated ER diagram generation system that progressively increases prompting complexity based on requirement complexity levels.
idea_ch: 一种结合Chain of Thought+Verifier提示技术的方法，利用大语言模型从自然语言需求生成实体关系图，提高结构一致性。
一种将Chain of Thought推理与验证模块相结合的提示工程框架，用于校验LLM输出的概念建模结果。
一种基于需求复杂度级别渐进增加提示复杂度的自动化ER图生成系统。

title: Random-Set Graph Neural Networks
summary: Uncertainty quantification has become an important factor in understanding the data representations produced by Graph Neural Networks (GNNs). Despite their predictive capabilities being ever useful across industrial workspaces, the inherent uncertainty induced by the nature of the data is a huge mitigating factor to GNN performance. While aleatoric uncertainty is the result of noisy and incomplete stochastic data such as missing edges or over-smoothing, epistemic uncertainty arises from lack of knowledge about a system or model (e.g., a graph's topology or node feature representation), which can be reduced by gathering more data and information. In this paper, we propose an original new framework in which node-level epistemic uncertainty is modelled in a belief function (finite random set) formalism. The resulting Random-Set Graph Neural Networks have a belief-function head predicting a random set over the list of classes, from which both a precise probability prediction and a measure of epistemic uncertainty can be obtained. Extensive experiments on 9 different graph learning datasets, including real-world autonomous driving benchmarks as such Nuscene and ROAD, demonstrate RS-GNN's superior uncertainty quantification capabilities

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于随机集理论（Random Set Theory）的图神经网络框架RS-GNN，通过在分类器头部引入置信函数（belief function）来建模节点级别的认知不确定性，从而提升GNN在工业场景中的不确定性量化能力。
AI.motivation: 图神经网络在工业应用中表现优异，但数据本身的随机性（如缺失边、过度平滑）和模型知识不足（如图拓扑结构）引入的不确定性严重限制了GNN的性能，亟需一种能够有效量化节点级不确定性的方法。
AI.method: 提出RS-GNN框架，在GNN分类头部采用置信函数（有限随机集）形式，预测类别集上的随机集分布，从而同时输出精确的概率预测和认知不确定性度量。
AI.result: 在9个图学习数据集（包括NuScenes、ROAD等真实自动驾驶基准）上的实验表明，RS-GNN在不确定性量化方面表现优异。
AI.conclusion: 基于随机集的置信函数方法能够有效建模图节点级别的认知不确定性，为GNN在工业高风险场景中的可靠部署提供了新途径。
idea_en: Random-Set Graph Neural Network (RS-GNN): A belief-function head that predicts a random set over class labels for node-level epistemic uncertainty quantification.
Belief function formalism for GNN uncertainty: Using finite random set theory to model both aleatoric and epistemic uncertainty in graph data.
Uncertainty-aware GNN for autonomous driving: Application of RS-GNN to real-world benchmarks like NuScenes and ROAD for safety-critical perception tasks.
Node-level epistemic uncertainty as a random set over classes: A method to derive both precise probability predictions and uncertainty measures from the same belief-function head.
idea_ch: 基于随机集的图神经网络（RS-GNN）：在分类头部使用置信函数预测类别集上的随机集分布，实现节点级认知不确定性量化。
有限随机集理论用于GNN不确定性建模：利用随机集形式同时刻画偶然不确定性（数据噪声）和认知不确定性（知识缺失）。
面向自动驾驶的不确定性感知GNN：将RS-GNN应用于NuScenes、ROAD等真实自动驾驶基准数据集，服务于安全关键感知任务。
节点级认知不确定性作为类别的随机集：从同一个置信函数头部同时输出精确概率预测和不确定性度量，无需额外网络分支。

title: BadSKP: Backdoor Attacks on Knowledge Graph-Enhanced LLMs with Soft Prompts
summary: Recent knowledge graph (KG)-enhanced large language models (LLMs) move beyond purely textual knowledge augmentation by encoding retrieved subgraphs into continuous soft prompts via graph neural networks, introducing a graph-conditioned channel that operates alongside the standard text interface. However, existing backdoor attacks are largely designed for the textual channel, and their effectiveness against this dual-channel architecture remains unclear. We show that this architecture creates a robustness gap: text-channel backdoor attacks that readily compromise textual KG prompting systems become largely ineffective against soft-prompt-based counterparts. We interpret this gap through semantic anchoring, whereby graph-derived soft prompts bias the generation-driving hidden state toward query-consistent semantics and suppress surface-level malicious instructions. Because this anchoring effect is itself induced by the graph channel, an attacker who manipulates graph-level representations can in turn redirect it toward adversarial semantics. To demonstrate this risk, we propose BadSKP, a backdoor attack that targets the graph-to-prompt interface through a multi-stage optimization strategy: it constructs adversarial target embeddings, optimizes poisoned node embeddings to steer the induced soft prompt, and approximates the optimized representations with fluent adversarial node attributes. Experiments on two soft-prompt KG-enhanced LLMs across four datasets show that BadSKP achieves high attack success under both frozen and trojaned settings, while text-only attacks remain unreliable even under perplexity-based defenses.

AI.tldr: 本文发现知识图谱增强的大语言模型（KG-LLM）存在鲁棒性缺口：文本通道的后门攻击对软提示架构失效，但攻击者可通过操纵图通道实现高效后门攻击。作者提出BadSKP，一种针对图到提示接口的多阶段优化后门攻击方法，实验证明其在多个数据集上成功率高，而纯文本攻击即使有防御也不可靠。
AI.motivation: 现有后门攻击主要针对文本通道，但对于KG增强LLM这种双通道（文本+图）架构的有效性未知。作者发现文本通道攻击对软提示架构几乎无效，但图通道存在被利用的风险，因此需要研究如何利用图通道实施后门攻击。
AI.method: 提出BadSKP，包括三阶段优化：1）构建对抗目标嵌入；2）优化中毒节点嵌入以引导软提示；3）用流畅的对抗节点属性逼近优化后的表示。该攻击针对图到提示（graph-to-prompt）接口，通过操纵图级表示来重定向语义锚定效应。
AI.result: 在两种软提示KG增强LLM和四个数据集上，BadSKP在冻结和木马设置下均实现高攻击成功率，而纯文本攻击即使基于困惑度防御也仍不可靠。
AI.conclusion: KG增强LLM的双通道架构存在新的攻击面，图通道的后门攻击比文本通道更有效且隐蔽，需要开发针对图通道的防御机制。
idea_en: A multi-stage optimization backdoor attack method targeting the graph-to-prompt interface in knowledge graph-enhanced large language models, comprising: constructing adversarial target embeddings, optimizing poisoned node embeddings to steer induced soft prompts, and approximating optimized representations with fluent adversarial node attributes.

A method for exploiting the semantic anchoring effect in soft-prompt-based KG-enhanced LLMs, where graph-derived soft prompts bias hidden states toward query-consistent semantics, by manipulating graph-level representations to redirect this anchoring effect toward adversarial semantics.

A backdoor attack framework (BadSKP) that achieves high attack success under both frozen and trojaned settings on KG-enhanced LLMs, while remaining effective against perplexity-based defenses that thwart text-only attacks.
idea_ch: 一种针对知识图谱增强大语言模型中图到提示接口的多阶段优化后门攻击方法，包括：构建对抗目标嵌入、优化中毒节点嵌入以引导诱导的软提示、用流畅的对抗节点属性逼近优化后的表示。
一种利用软提示KG增强LLM中语义锚定效应的攻击方法，通过操纵图级表示将锚定效应重定向到对抗语义，从而绕过文本通道的安全机制。
一种在冻结和木马设置下均能实现高攻击成功率的后门攻击框架BadSKP，能够有效对抗基于困惑度的文本防御方法。

title: LegalCheck: Retrieval- and Context-Augmented Generation for Drafting Municipal Legal Advice Letters
comment: Accepted at ICAIL 2026 as Short Paper
summary: Public-sector legal departments in the Netherlands face acute staff shortages, increased case volumes, and increased pressure to meet regulatory compliance. This paper presents LegalCheck, a novel system that addresses these challenges by automating the drafting of objection response letters through a combination of Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) and Context-Augmented Generation (CAG). Using a large language model (LLM) alongside curated legal knowledge bases, LegalCheck performs retrieval of relevant laws and precedents, and uses controlled prompting to incorporate both external knowledge and case-specific details into a coherent draft. An expert-in-the-loop review ensures that each generated letter is legally sound and contextually appropriate. In a real-world deployment within the Municipality of Amsterdam, LegalCheck produced near-final advice letters in minutes rather than hours, while maintaining high legal consistency and factual accuracy. The output is based on actual regulations and prior cases, providing explainable outputs that captured the vast majority of required legal reasoning (often 80\% to 100\% of essential content). Legal professionals found that the system reduced their workload and ensured a consistent application of legal standards, without replacing human judgment. These results demonstrate substantial efficiency gains, improved legal consistency, and positive user acceptance. More broadly, this work illustrates how responsible AI can be deployed in the legal domain by augmenting LLMs with domain knowledge and governance mechanisms.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了LegalCheck系统，该系统结合检索增强生成(RAG)和上下文增强生成(CAG)技术，为荷兰公共部门法律部门自动化起草异议回复信函。该系统在阿姆斯特丹市政厅实际部署，将起草时间从数小时缩短至数分钟，同时保持80%-100%的法律推理准确性。
AI.motivation: 荷兰公共部门法律部门面临严重的人员短缺、案件数量增加和合规压力，传统人工起草法律文件耗时长且资源紧张。
AI.method: 结合RAG（检索相关法律法规和判例）和CAG（上下文增强生成），通过受控提示词将外部知识和案件细节融入LLM生成过程，并引入专家审查机制确保法律合理性。
AI.result: 在阿姆斯特丹市政厅的实际部署中，起草时间从数小时缩短至数分钟，输出覆盖80%-100%的必要法律推理内容，法律专业人员认可其减轻工作负担并确保法律标准的一致性。
AI.conclusion: LegalCheck证明了通过AI增强法律工作的可行性和效率，展示了负责任的AI通过领域知识增强和治理机制在法律领域的部署路径。
idea_en: A hybrid RAG-CAG architecture for legal document generation that retrieves relevant laws and precedents from curated knowledge bases while simultaneously incorporating case-specific context through controlled prompting.
An expert-in-the-loop verification framework for LLM-generated legal documents, ensuring legal soundness and contextual appropriateness without fully automating human judgment.
A domain-specific legal knowledge curation method that structures laws and precedents for efficient retrieval and integration into LLM-based drafting workflows.
